jobs.title: Program/Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
1.0 FTE Full time Day - 08 Hour R2659135 Hybrid 107420001 Surg Svcs OR Multi Site Business & Administration PALO ALTO, 500 Pasteur Dr, California

If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

  
Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)

**This is a Stanford Health Care job.**  
  
**A Brief Overview**  
Plans, coordinates, and participates in the performance of varied and responsible work in the administration, project administration and operation of specialized programs or projects. Provides varied and complex project administrative support and technical assistance to managerial staff (with a focus on assigned projects, programs and operations). These activities include budget preparation, reconciliation and monitoring; report preparation and conducting preliminary analyses and liaison with other project coordinators for coordinating and facilitating the smooth operation of projects.  
  
**Locations**  
Stanford Health Care  
  
**What you will do**

* Plans, coordinates, and participates in the implementation of activities including, but not limited to: seminars, conferences, workshops, fairs and other related programs. Develops and coordinates new ideas and concepts for program themes. Coordinate all program logistics, materials and resources.
* Provides administrative assistance to management staff within assigned areas to support the accomplishment of program objectives.
* May provide work-lead direction and/or train others.
* Plans, coordinates, and administers activities of assigned programs to include developing, implementing, and supervising related procedures, processes, services and systems. Train employees in proper methods and procedures and ensure correctness of work.
* Advises manager as to the status of current activities and additional or expanded program requirements. Makes recommendations for solutions to problems identified.
* Monitors and evaluates program effectiveness, investigate trends, and recommend and implement modifications to supervisor/manager to improve program effectiveness.
* Coordinates and/or participates in a variety of public or agency facing activities including the preparation and planned release of documents, reports and related materials and responds to inquiries. Manages access to hospital regulatory and compliance software, manages the implementation of the hospital’s policy management tools and committees.
* Maintains liaison with other programs, offices, and departments across SHC to coordinate program business and to accomplish program objectives. Interfaces with external organizations, such as Joint Commission and California Department of Public Health (CDPH), as appropriate to ensure cooperative efforts are enhanced and available resources are utilized.
* Assists in the preparation of budgets. Monitors, verifies, and reconciles expenditure of budgeted funds as appropriate.
* Prepares reports and conducts preliminary analyses setting forth progress and adverse trends. Provides input into appropriate program recommendations or conclusions.
* Maintains files and records pertaining to various clinical locations and the hospital such as licenses to conduct business, city, county and state permits, and may prepare reports to requesting agencies.
* Performs other related and incidental duties as assigned or needed.

**Education Qualifications**

* A high school diploma OR GED equivalent.

**Experience Qualifications**

* Four (4) years of increasingly responsible administrative support experience (with a focus on supporting projects, budget preparation, monitoring and reconciliation and report preparation).

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Knowledge of general practices, program, and/or administrative specialty.
* Knowledge of and proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Suite applications and standard office equipment.
* Knowledge of English grammar, spelling, and punctuation.
* Familiarity and understanding of project management principles and practices.
* Ability to take initiative and independently plan, organize, coordinate, and perform work in various situations where numerous and diverse demands are involved.
* Ability to learn, interpret, and apply a wide variety of policies and procedures relating to and impacting the applicable program, organizational unit, and/or administrative specialty.
* Ability to organize and plan work and projects including handling multiple priorities.
* Ability to make independent decisions and exercise sound judgment.
* Ability to compile, write, and present reports related to program or administrative specialty.
* Ability to communicate effectively, using C-I-CARE, both orally and in writing.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships within and outside the work group and serve as a liaison for the organizational unit.

**Licenses and Certifications**

* None

**These principles apply to ALL employees:**  
  
**SHC Commitment to Providing an Exceptional Patient & Family Experience**  
  
*Stanford Health Care sets a high standard for delivering value and an exceptional experience for our patients and families. Candidates for employment and existing employees must adopt and execute C-I-CARE standards for all of patients, families and towards each other. C-I-CARE is the foundation of Stanford’s patient-experience and represents a framework for patient-centered interactions. Simply put, we do what it takes to enable and empower patients and families to focus on health, healing and recovery.*  
  
*You will do this by executing against our three experience pillars, from the patient and family’s perspective:*

jobs.title: Program Coordinator_School Partnership
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Program Coordinator leads day-to-day planning, implementation, and documentation of Eden Youth’s integrated youth substance use prevention portfolio, including scheduling and partnerships with districts and school sites. Current programs include Friday Night Live (FNL) chapters, Stanford REACH Lab prevention curricula (such as Smart Talk, opioid/fentanyl awareness, Our Healthy Futures, and age-appropriate vape-free education), and the Familia Adelante curriculum and family workshops. The Coordinator aligns program delivery with school calendars, grant requirements, evaluation protocols, and the Senior Program Manager’s priorities, and incorporates youth voice throughout. The position also supervises, trains, and coaches facilitators and peer educators. This is a prevention role; it does not provide substance use disorder diagnosis or clinical treatment.

**JOB FUNCTIONS AND ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

**School partnerships and implementation**

Serve as the primary liaison between schools, districts, staff, and community partners to coordinate program planning, approvals, scheduling, referrals, and implementation. Ensure culturally responsive, age-appropriate, and accessible services across middle and high schools, including seasonal programming. Maintain site trackers to monitor attendance, program delivery, evaluations, staffing, challenges, and follow-up actions while supporting partnership agreements and renewals.

**Stanford REACH Lab curricula and appropriate intervention**

Coordinate the effective delivery of Stanford REACH Lab substance-use prevention curricula, including cannabis, vaping, opioid/fentanyl awareness, and alternatives to suspension. Schedule and support trained educators, monitor curriculum fidelity, and address implementation concerns. Collaborate with school teams to manage referrals, ensure confidential student support, and coordinate pre/post-surveys using approved Stanford data collection tools.

**Friday Night Live and youth leadership**

Coordinate Friday Night Live (FNL) chapters, youth leadership meetings, prevention campaigns, and school activities while promoting youth participation and ownership. Collaborate with the Youth Advisory Council (YAC) on youth-led projects, community outreach, and advocacy. Train and mentor youth leaders in communication, project planning, inclusive leadership, prevention messaging, and responsible reporting.

**Familia Adelante and caregiver engagement**

Coordinate culturally responsive Familia Adelante workshops and caregiver education in partnership with schools, families, and bilingual facilitators. Manage outreach, scheduling, translation and interpretation, registration, attendance, and follow-up while maintaining confidentiality. Ensure county-funded program requirements are met and documented separately from other funded activities.

**Enhanced Care Management (ECM) and Community Health Connections**

Introduce ECM and Community Connect services to school counselors, family engagement staff, and student support teams. Identify potential referral opportunities for students and families experiencing complex health or social needs. Coordinate referrals to staff for Medi-Cal and CYBHI eligibility verification, assessment, and enrollment determination. Support connections to behavioral health services, and other community programs. Follow up on referral coordination while maintaining confidentiality and respecting family consent.

**Deliverables, evaluation, and contract compliance**

Maintain funder-specific work plans, documentation, and reporting to ensure contract compliance and prevent duplicate billing or reporting. Coordinate accurate data collection, timely submissions, evaluations, and quality assurance. Support county reporting deadlines, annual prevention planning, stakeholder feedback, and continuous program improvement. Collaborate with management and partners to fulfill prevention and youth engagement deliverables.

**Team coordination, safety, and professionalism**

Provide guidance, onboarding, and coaching to peer educators, youth specialists, and interns while collaborating with supervisors to support team development, staffing needs, and program effectiveness. Ensure compliance with mandated reporting, youth safety, district policies, confidentiality, and trauma-informed practices. Participate in required professional development to maintain program quality and professionalism.

**QUALIFICATIONS (KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES)**

Strong organizational, coordination, and facilitation skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, multiple school sites, and concurrent program deadlines.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with students, families, school personnel, staff, and community partners.

Exercises sound judgment, makes well-reasoned decisions, and develops practical solutions to operational and program-related challenges.

Demonstrates adaptability, embraces responsible organizational change, and supports continuous improvement in alignment with the organization's mission.

Maintains a results-oriented approach, follows through on commitments, and consistently meets established deadlines and performance expectations.

Demonstrates active listening, cultural humility, and respect for diverse perspectives while modeling inclusive and professional behavior.

Demonstrates accountability, ethical conduct, professionalism, and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

**Required Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience, with at least two years coordinating youth, school-based, prevention, or community programs.

Strong organizational, communication, relationship-building, and culturally responsive facilitation skills.

Proficiency in Microsoft 365, data tracking, and reporting systems.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

At Lucile Packard Children’s Hospital Stanford, we know world-renowned care begins with world-class caring. That's why we combine advanced technologies and breakthrough discoveries with family-centered care. It's why we provide our caregivers with continuing education and state-of-the-art facilities, like the newly remodeled Lucile Packard Children's Hospital Stanford. And it's why we need caring, committed people on our team - like you. Join us on our mission to heal humanity, one child and family at a time.  
  
**Job ID:** LP\_00024850-2661065

 **Job Description**

**JOB SUMMARY**

This paragraph summarizes the general nature, level and purpose of the job.

The Program Coordinator is responsible for operational issues related to supporting programs/activities, including, but not limited to, overseeing and coordinating the day-to-day operations and resources. Serves as a resource for staff, faculty, outside agencies/institutions, and customers. Serves as a resource for marketing, communication, tracking programmatic statistics, and logistics for various projects. The coordinator will support the Manager and Director in working on multifaceted programs in alignment with evidence-based practice and research. Coordinating the programs, including scheduling, maintaining calendars, website updates, financial accounting, coordinating conferences, and managing travel arrangements. Resolves frequent routine problems and conflicts that arise as appropriate. Collaborates with others, exercises organizational skills, in coordinating events/departmental activities. Plans and carries out assignments that are complex with minimum supervision.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

The essential functions listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification. They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned.

Employees must abide by all Joint Commission Requirements including but not limited to sensitivity to cultural diversity, patient care, patient rights and ethical treatment, safety and security of physical environments, emergency management, teamwork, respect for others, participation in ongoing education and training, communication and adherence to safety and quality programs, sustaining compliance with National Patient Safety Goals, and licensure and health screenings.

Must perform all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the hospital's policies and procedures, including its Service Standards and its Code of Conduct.

* Create, manage, and maintain the schedule for multiple programs
* Manages all data analysis for the multiple programs needs. This involves analyzing and determining required reports and collaborating with multiple partners to create the necessary reports.
* Build relationships and coordinate with internal and external vendors on the necessary training activities for all CPEI programs.
* Facilitate and analyze budgeting activities to optimize programs.
* Creates and manages complex programs, spreadsheets, databases, reports, queries, charts, etc., based on department projects or activities/objectives.
* Coordinates and organizes special events, conferences, and meetings (staff and patient-focused), including planning, facilitation, and implementation.
* Analyze and compile recommendations for program changes to improve the management of complex systems.
* Organizes projects as they arise, analyzes, provides direction regarding additional areas of opportunity, and presents results.
* Collaborates with internal/external stakeholders and coordinators to integrate programs and structures to support CPEI.
* Designs and creates templates, standardized processes, and tracking of programs/activities.
* Manages project schedules and program resources by coordinating activities and ensuring project phases are documented appropriately and completed within the designated time allotment.
* Coordinates and organizes special events, conferences, and meetings (staff and patient-focused), including planning, facilitation, and implementation.
* Prepares agenda for meetings; manages department database updates and creates monthly reports specific to departmental/unit operations and activities
* Collaborates with manager to optimize efficient workflows for programs.
* Assists in building budget and reconciliation for program/activity expenses.
* Develop and maintain business book describing the structure and process for each program.
* Maintains filling system, office logistics, and records for the office.
* Processes contracts and equipment transactions, including purchase orders and requisitions.
* Reviews invoices to ensure that items are correct in the description, quantity, unit price, and total price.
* Guarantees timely submission of evaluations and paperwork associated with the smooth functioning of policies and procedures
* Develops programs compliance and analysis results
* Collaborates with Managers, Directors, stakeholders, and others to optimize efficient workflows for program management.
* Provides administrative coordination to the program, such as coordinating work meetings and conferences for staff.
* Organize work and coordinate duties with team members to maximize departmental effectiveness and efficiencies.

Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications is qualifying.

**Education:** Bachelor's degree.

**Experience:** Three (3) years of experience in a related work area.

**License/Certification:** None required.

jobs.title: People Partner
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
Diamond Foundry Inc. is solving the thermal limitation at the foundation of today's most exciting tech industries - AI & cloud compute, electric-car power electronics, and 5G/6G wireless. We have managed to produce the world's first single-crystal diamond wafers and are now on a mission to put a diamond behind every chip. We are the rare unicorn that has grown fast and profitably. We received $515m in funding and are executing a multi-$B expansion plan for one of the greenest forms of tech manufacturing: converting greenhouse gas into diamond wafers using zero-emission energy.

Diamond Foundry is seeking a People Partner to support our Bay Area Diamond Foundry locations and our direct-to-consumer brand, VRAI.

The ideal candidate has supported both a shift-based and a corporate or customer-facing population and is comfortable moving between a production floor and a showroom in the same week. They are hands-on, practical, and credible with frontline managers. This is a role with room to grow, working closely with the VP of Human Resources on more complex matters.

### **Responsibilities**

* Partner with managers across diverse teams on daily people matters—including performance, attendance, and team dynamics—coaching them to conduct difficult conversations, resolve issues consistently, and document properly rather than handling matters on their behalf.
* Support employee relations by conducting independent investigations and collaborating closely with the VP of HR on complex or sensitive matters.
* Support multi-state accommodation and return-to-work processes in coordination with People Operations.
* Drive compensation and leveling initiatives, including new hire offers, promotions, and the annual merit cycle.
* Tailor and translate company-wide programs to effectively suit both shift-based manufacturing and retail environments, accounting for how different populations experience shared policies.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience with 4+ years in an HR or People Partner capacity, featuring hands-on employee relations experience (HR certification is a plus).
* Proven experience supporting both a non-exempt, shift-based workforce and a corporate or customer-facing population.
* Working knowledge of California employment law—particularly regarding leave, accommodation, and wage-and-hour requirements—with multi-state exposure preferred.
* Demonstrated track record of coaching managers, applying consistent standards across varying team cultures, and exercising sound judgment on when to act independently versus when to escalate.
* Experience navigating and building out processes within an evolving, high-growth environment (desirable).

The position is eligible for company shares. Actual compensation may be higher or lower in the range based on various factors, including, but not limited to a candidate’s job duties, experience, and location. We will also consider higher-level candidates and salary will be adjusted accordingly.

Diamond Foundry believes in supporting our employees from the workplace to their personal and home life. We provide eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. Perks include employee discounts to VRAI. Our benefits begin as early as your first day of employment. Medical and vision coverage are retroactive to your start date, while dental and voluntary benefits take effect once you’ve completed your enrollment.

Diamond Foundry is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factor under federal, state or local law.

Diamond Foundry Inc. is committed to operating in full compliance with all applicable state and federal laws. Our commitment extends to ensuring that our manufacturing and engineering departments adhere to the highest standards of legal and regulatory compliance. Additionally, these departments may have specific physical requirements to ensure the safety and efficiency of our operations. We prioritize the well-being of our employees and strive to create a work environment that promotes both legal compliance and the optimal functioning of our manufacturing and engineering processes.

Manufacturing and Engineering Departments Physical Requirements:

* Use appropriate PPE and follow all safety policies, practices, and procedures.
* This position will often: Sit, stand for long periods, walk, grasp, reach with hands and arms, lift below and above shoulders, bend, twist at the waist, climb, balance, stoop, squat, kneel, crawl, talk, hear, see, use fine finger manipulation, and complete repetitive motions.
* Some tasks may require the use of ladders or stairs
* Some tasks may require driving or the use of foot controls
* Lift/carry and push/pull up to 50 pound

jobs.title: Intensive Case Manager
jobs.description:
The Intensive Home Service Provider provides an intensive form of case management that facilitates care coordination for children and youth in foster care or Juvenile Justice System, or at risk of out-of-home placement. The IHSP provides skill building sessions directly to clients as well as parent coaching. IHSP’s facilitate Child and Family Team (CFT) meetings and supports the ICC in necessary tasks related to stabilizing a client’s symptoms and improving their functioning.

**What we can offer you:**

* Signing Bonus
* Hybrid Remote Model with company laptop
* Realistic caseload
* 12 Paid Holidays, and a Floating Holiday!
* Paid Vacation and Sick time
* Comprehensive benefit plan with four Health Plan Options (we pay 95% of premiums!)
* 403(b) Retirement Plan with match
* Additional pay for bilingual staff
* Eligibility for the State Loan Forgiveness Program
* Free access to Headspace mindfulness application

**Duties and responsibilities**

* Coordinate care for clients with a multidisciplinary clinical team and outside agencies including developing effective working relationships with agencies and organizations to advocate for clients.
* Work collaboratively with the Intensive Care Coordinator assigned to the case to assist in monitoring progress for effectiveness of interventions and make decisions regarding the need to adjust treatment or find additional resources and supports.
* Provide collaborative, culturally sensitive, strengths based, client centered individual/group/family rehabilitation services to youth and their families.
* Complete all documentation per Medi-Cal, Santa Clara County and AACI standards within expected deadlines.
* Schedule, facilitate and participate in Child and Family Team (CFT) meetings.
* Facilitate referral linkages to community resources and perform case management services.
* Participate in clinical supervision, consultations, trainings, and team meetings.
* Assist clients with the development of social and community support systems.
* Complete other related duties and projects as assigned.

**Qualifications**

Education & Experience:

* Bachelor's degree in social work or a related field; or equivalent education, training, and experience.
* One year or more of case management and rehabilitation services experience working with parents and youth.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

* Knowledge of community and county resources to facilitate referrals and coordination with appropriate agencies.
* Knowledge of trauma informed care.
* Knowledge of the child welfare system and juvenile probation system preferred.
* Knowledge of mandated reporter laws in California.
* Knowledge of crisis de-escalation interventions.
* Proficient writing skills.
* Proficiency in usage of basic technological tools including laptops/computers, email, phones, and internet required.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite required.
* Ability to maintain a valid California driver license, current personal auto insurance, and an MVR sufficient to maintain insurability under agency auto liability.
* Verbal and written fluency in English required; Bilingual skills in a second language (particularly Spanish, Mandarin, Vietnamese) desired but not required.

***Competencies:***

* Ability to communicate well with people of diverse cultural professional and experiential backgrounds.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective work relationships as part of a multi-disciplinary team.

**Working conditions**

This job requires you to be in the community, in client’s homes, and other community partner sites. Work is often conducted in an office environment. Basic safety precautions and use of protective clothing or gear may be required. Working with clients who are seriously mentally ill, or high risk may increase exposure to secondary trauma. Driving is essential to the function of this job. The job requires travel up to 25% of the time. Occasional evening and weekend work is required.

**Physical requirements**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to regularly sit for extended periods of time and regularly operate a computer and use manual dexterity for tasks such as keyboarding. The mental demands of the job include regular comprehension, reasoning, decision making, interpreting and analyzing data, organizing, reading, writing, and resilience.

*AACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

jobs.title: Bilingual Case Manager II
jobs.description:
Catholic Charities Housing Support Services “To provide individual and crisis intervention counseling and services to program clients in order to ensure opportunity for clients to maintain their housing. To implement and deliver all aspects of peer support and to assist program participants in achieving short- and long-term goals.”

The Case Manager will be responsible for core housing case management, benefits advocacy, support services for physical and mental health – acute/chronic, and problem solving. Provide assistance to people accessing other applicable housing opportunities. Assist clients in maintaining or increasing their housing stabilization.

Working to assess the Participants needs, by providing immediate services, personal goals, and services plans. This position will work with Participants around self-sufficiency, and how to maintain independence and prevent homelessness. Through the program, clients may receive case management referrals to community support and counseling.

The Case Manager provides advocacy and referral services as needed to Participants, and where possible, assist with maintaining housing.

* Caseload portfolio assignment up to 35-40 clients
* Provide comprehensive screening and assessment of clients and services needed.
* Develop person centered care plans: provide counseling, monitoring and care plan changes as necessary.
* Arrange for services to meet the client’s needs as documented in the care plan to address the immediate and long-term needs of clients.
* Provide practical support, education and assistance to tenants in addressing immediate needs related to achieving stability and life management skills, with a minimum of monthly client contact.
* Coordinate with the Catholic Charities CYO programs and community agencies to ensure communication and quality service to the clients.
* Provide on-going support including but not limited to the following: information and referral for services, client contact, and assist in meeting the goals of the client’s service plan.
* Comply with program policies and procedures to protect client and caregiver interests and facilitate the smooth operation of the program.
* Maintain accurate, current, and complete client files and complete all required data collection forms and reports. Maintain appropriate records for monthly reports.
* Data entry into CARES Systems and completion of monthly reports.
* Participate in staff meetings, client peer reviews, in-services and other training as required.
* Coordinate contact with collaborative agencies as needed to identify any client issues that might result in an improved or destabilize a housing and to conduct an appropriate intervention as required
* Interface with other agencies and departments to ensure appropriate client compliance with Program requirements.
* Other duties as assigned
* Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Education & Experience:**

* BA degree and one year of experience preferred or AA degree and three years related experience. (Equivalent education and experience demonstrating the ability to perform the job may be considered.)
* Two years experience providing client case management services with the housing insecure population and/or service programs preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:**

* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Knowledge of San Francisco County social services networks.
* Sensitivity to and possess a knowledge of services for seniors and adults with disabilities, homelessness/unstable housing, substance use disorders, and associated Healthcare [physical and mental health – acute/chronic] issues.
* Certified or familiarity with HCV/Housing Quality Standards.
* Interacting with persons from various social, cultural, economic, and educational backgrounds for the purpose of stabilizing or improving housing situations.
* Bilingual in Spanish, Tagalog, Mandarin/Chinese, or other language preferred.
* Functional knowledge of Microsoft Office Products.
* Ability to perform duties with minimum supervision.
* Ability to communicate clearly in both verbal and written forms.
* Promote a positive professional and organizational image in the community.
* Sensitivity to seniors and people with disabilities and their needs.
* Knowledge of mandatory reporting requirements for people working with ageing adults.
* Sensitivity in handling complex/confidential information.
* Ability to work under pressure.
* Ability to work as a member of a team.
* Valid CA Driver’s License and personal car preferred
* Demonstrates the necessary attitudes, knowledge and skills to deliver culturally competent services and work effectively in cross-cultural situations.

**Prerequisites Required Prior to the First Day of Employment:**

Fingerprints: **Required**

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description:
**About Bonsai Robotics**

Bonsai Robotics develops affordable, vision-based autonomy that makes off-road equipment smarter, safer, and more productive. We are redefining outdoor autonomy with Bonsai Intelligence, a connected platform that’s inspired by biology to see, think, and act with precision like a human. We bring together advanced perception, embodied AI, integrations with equipment manufacturers, and our compact, modular Amiga vehicles to deliver reliable automation to the world’s most demanding field operations—reducing costs and increasing operational efficiencies.

**About the role**

We’re looking for an Office Manager to keep our San Jose and Watsonville offices running smoothly. You’ll be the go-to person for everything that makes the workplace work, from facilities and vendors to supplies, mail, and the day-to-day details that help our team stay focused on building robots.

This role splits time between both offices. You’ll own internal office projects from start to finish, support our real estate needs as we grow, and provide hands-on support to our leadership team. It’s a great fit for someone who is organized, resourceful, and enjoys building structure in a fast-moving startup.

**What you'll do**

* Manage day-to-day operations for our San Jose and Watsonville offices, including facilities, maintenance, vendors, badge access, and office equipment
* Lead internal office projects like space planning, moves, buildouts, and workplace improvements, from scoping through completion
* Support real estate needs, including lease administration, landlord communication, and coordination with brokers
* Order and stock snacks, beverages, and supplies for both offices, and manage related budgets and vendor relationships
* Open, scan, and distribute incoming mail and packages, and manage outgoing shipments
* Provide executive support, including calendar coordination, meeting logistics, and ad hoc projects
* Coordinate company wide events, on-site meetings, visitor check-in, and in-office lunches
* Travel regularly between the San Jose and Watsonville offices to keep both sites running consistently

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in office management, facilities, or administrative operations, ideally at a startup or tech company
* Experience supporting multiple office locations or a distributed team
* Exposure to real estate, lease administration, or facilities projects is a plus
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to juggle competing priorities without dropping details
* Clear, professional communicator who’s comfortable working with executives, vendors, and landlords
* Proficient with Google Workspace and quick to pick up new tools
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for regular travel between San Jose and Watsonville
* Self-starter who takes ownership and brings a positive, service-minded approach

**Life at Bonsai Robotics**

At Bonsai, we're building the future of robotics and we know that means investing in our people. We're committed to creating a workplace where you can do your best work, grow your skills, and feel genuinely part of something bigger.

**Hybrid Flexibility (for selective roles)**

We operate on a hybrid model because we believe the best collaboration happens both in person and from where you work best. You'll have the flexibility to split your time between our office and home, so you can stay connected to the team while maintaining the balance that works for you.

**Work-life Balance**

The best employees are those who create balance in their lives, which is why we prioritize balance and well-being for everyone at Bonsai. We foster a supportive environment where teammates look out for each other.

**Covered Lunch**

On in-office days, we've got lunch covered. It's a small thing that makes a big difference, with more time to connect with teammates and less to worry about.

**Wellness and Benefits**

Your health matters. We offer comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision), mental health support, and wellness programs designed to help you thrive both physically and mentally.

**Collaborative Culture**

At Bonsai, you're not just part of a team, you're part of a community. We celebrate wins together, support each other through challenges, and genuinely enjoy the people we work with. From team events to cross-functional collaboration, we're building something together.

**Mission-driven Work**

Every day, you're contributing to advancements in robotics that matter. If you're excited about innovation and impact, you'll find it here.

Bonsai Robotics is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status or any other category protected by law.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
75,000 - 75,000 USD per year(San Jose)

Rocket Youth owns and operates a growing portfolio of youth sports, enrichment, and after-school businesses across the United States. Our platform is intentionally multi-brand and multi-location, with each business maintaining its unique identity and local market focus.

jobs.title: Executive Operations and Office Manager
jobs.description:
Develop Health is on a mission to use AI to radically accelerate access to life-saving medications. By automating complex, manual healthcare processes—like benefit verification and prior authorization— **we've been growing rapidly and over the past couple of years have helped over 3.6 million patients!**

We’re partnering with some of the largest pharmacy benefit managers and payers in the nation, revolutionizing how healthcare interactions occur by eliminating human delays and inefficiencies. Our small, elite team of founders and engineers have previously launched and exited successful healthcare startups including Rupa Health and Canvas Medical. We are now scaling rapidly following a major funding round.

**The Role**
------------

Our executives spend their days building the product and closing deals with the biggest names in healthcare and life sciences. You'll keep everything around them running smoothly, while also ensuring our offices are productive, collaborative places to work that celebrate our team.

65% of your time goes to supporting our CEO, CTO and Chief Commercial Officer: their calendars, travel, meetings and relationships, plus the culture work that keeps our team connected. The other 35% goes to employee engagement and running our core office in San Francisco and satellite office in Menlo Park. You'll report to our Senior Manager, Strategy & Finance.

You’ll be the first full-time partner to our leaders, able to unlock a new level of focus and support. You’ll help us optimize our Menlo office, including transitioning it to a smaller satellite space in mid-2027, while helping us open and optimize our new, San Francisco office in January 2027.

The role is a match for someone who solves problems creatively, keeps finding better ways to do things, and has a gift for hospitality. As the company scales, special projects and increased responsibilities are likely. This is a great entry point into the company, and will give you visibility into the full business.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**Support our C-Suite**

* Own their calendars. Expect lots of external meetings, tricky scheduling and plans that change daily.
* Work with our Sr. Manager of Strategy and Finance to build agendas for team and leadership meetings, help run them, and capture notes and action items.
* Plan on-site and off-site meetings, dinners and team events.
* Book complex travel for our executives, arrange travel and accommodation for visitors coming to Develop Health, and prepare expense reports.
* Be the face and voice of Develop Health as you reach out on behalf of our team, and help us build great relationships with senior leaders at our partners and customers.

**Build our culture**

* Company-Wide: Nurture our fast-paced, collaborative, and active culture with team gatherings, lunches, and celebrations.
* For Individuals: Partner with our People and Talent team to bring the magic to onboarding, work anniversaries, birthdays, and special milestones.

**Run our offices**

* Set up both offices to be productive, collaborative workspaces that folks are excited to come into each week: choose and manage vendors, organize the spaces, and create our office manual, routines and protocols.
* Keep the SF office clean, organized and ready for the team. That means non-janitorial tidying of common areas, meeting rooms, the kitchen and storage.
* Keep us stocked with everything from stationery to snacks, drinks and coffee.
* Coordinate team lunches, and set up for special events and All Hands.
* Troubleshoot Zoom and Google Meet room devices, room booking tablets, and AirPlay or cable connections for all hands meetings.
* Handle mail, packages and shipping for the team.
* Be the main contact for office vendors, including catering, building management and maintenance.

**About you**
-------------

* You’re excited to work onsite in San Francisco, Tuesday through Thursday each week, with a day in Menlo Park every other week to ensure that office is flowing. Time in Menlo may decrease as we transition this to a satellite office.
* You have 3+ years supporting a senior executive at a fast-paced company
* You've worked in office management, workplace experience or operations.
* You can juggle many requests that each feel urgent to the person asking. You prioritize, keep people updated, and get it all done without losing your cool.
* You move fast and make decisions on the spot without missing details. When things are ambiguous or changing, you stay calm and keep your sense of humor.
* You set a high bar. Nothing gets dropped, and our executives trust your work completely.
* You're AI-native. You use Claude to work faster, and you bring the judgment, taste and human touch that make every message feel thoughtful and polished.
* You're a straight shooter. If you disagree, you say so up front. If the answer is still no, you commit and make it happen.
* You spot needs before anyone asks and find solutions on your own.
* You're warm and welcoming, communicate clearly, and work well with all kinds of personalities.
* You're strong in Gmail, Google Calendar, Sheets, Slides, Excel and PowerPoint, and you can set up basic office A/V with confidence.
* You're reliable and punctual. You're online and responsive during business hours, closing loops to keep the team’s work flowing.

**Bonus points**
----------------

* You already have a system for supporting a busy executive team and running an office.
* You have experience in business operations, recruiting or HR and can help support the other biz ops staff

Compensation Range: $75K - $90K

jobs.title: Sales & Operations Lead (Management Track)

**Fem Boudoir Photo Studio| Concord, CA**

**Location:** Concord, CA | **This is a hybrid position**  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific  
**Compensation:** $55,000 Annual Base + Performance-Based Bonuses  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, W-2

About Fem Boudoir:

Fem Boudoir is a growing luxury boudoir photography studio based in Concord, California. We specialize in creating empowering, confidence-building photography experiences that help our clients see themselves in a whole new light.

We're a passionate team dedicated to providing an exceptional client experience, and we're looking for someone who is excited to grow with us.

**This isn't just another sales position. We're looking for someone with the potential to become a future leader of our company.**

About the Role:

We're seeking a motivated, personable, and results-driven Sales & Operations Lead to join our team.

Your primary focus will initially be managing incoming leads, conducting phone consultations, and converting prospective clients into booked photography sessions.

As you demonstrate strong sales performance, initiative, and leadership ability, you'll have the opportunity to take on additional operational responsibilities and potentially grow into an Operations Manager or General Manager role.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just wait to be told what to do, but takes ownership, identifies opportunities, and actively contributes to the success of the business.

What You'll Do:

**Sales & Client Experience**

* Conduct engaging phone consultations with prospective clients who have expressed interest in our photography experiences.
* Build genuine relationships, understand client needs, and confidently communicate the value of our services.
* Convert qualified leads into booked sessions while clearly communicating pricing expectations and the overall experience.
* Follow up with prospective clients through phone calls, texts, and emails.
* Handle questions and objections with confidence, empathy, and professionalism.
* Maintain accurate client information and follow-up activities in our CRM.
* Track booking performance and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

**Operations & Leadership Development**

* Proactively identify ways to improve workflows, client communication, and booking systems.
* Help coordinate schedules and communication between team members.
* Monitor key performance indicators and provide regular updates.
* Assist with resolving client concerns and operational challenges.
* Support team training, accountability, and process improvements as responsibilities expand.
* Gradually take on additional leadership responsibilities based on performance and business needs.

What We're Looking For:

**Required Qualifications**

* At least 2 years of successful phone sales, consultative sales, or appointment-closing experience.
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to make people feel comfortable and confident.
* Highly organized, dependable, and detail-oriented.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working independently.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to take ownership.
* Comfortable using CRM software and learning new technology.
* Genuine interest in professional growth and leadership.
* Must live within reasonable commuting distance of Concord, CA.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in high-ticket sales, luxury services, beauty, wellness, or photography.
* Experience with GoHighLevel, HoneyBook, or similar CRM systems.
* Previous experience training, mentoring, or leading a team.
* Experience working in a growing small business.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

You're someone who genuinely enjoys talking to people and helping them make confident decisions.

You love sales, but you're not pushy. You know how to listen, build trust, and communicate value.

You're organized, accountable, and comfortable working independently. When something isn't working, you don't simply point it out—you look for solutions.

Most importantly, you're ambitious. You're excited about the opportunity to grow beyond sales and eventually help lead a successful business.

This is a full-accountability leadership role. You will act as general manager for a set of high-impact programs. You will own outcomes, set strategy, and direct work across technical and business teams.

* Drive alignment with stakeholders and executive leadership. own decisions, escalations, and accountability.

**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

We have an opening for a **Mission Partner Sites IT Operations Associate** to oversee complex projects within the Enterprise Secure Network (ESN) Program and Mission Partner Sites. This position requires full-time on-site presence due to the nature of the work. This position is in the Information Technology Solutions Division (ITSD) within the Computing Directorate, in support of the LivIT Program.

*This position requires full-time on-site presence due to the nature of the work.*

* Contribute to the lines of effort required to onboard and deploy ESN connectivity to Mission Partner Sites.
* Represent the ESN Program as a liaison with Mission Partner Sites.
* Develop scalable processes and templates for integration efforts, to include required documentation such as Memorandums of Understanding (MOUs) or Bills of Material.
* Monitor, track, and report site integration status to ESN Program.

* Travel to customer sites to facilitate the deployment of new enterprise hardware.
* Maintain technical deployment schedules, prioritize work, track deliverables, administer the MPS Field Service Management tool, and update ServiceNow hardware asset records.

* Perform other duties as assigned.

* Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.

* Knowledge and experience working on technical projects.
* Knowledge of network administration, system administration, or triage.
* Knowledge of managing technical implementation projects.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills necessary to work collaboratively with customers or technical team members.

$107,610 - $136,500 Annually

Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities require separate approval. Hearing aids without wireless capabilities or wireless that has been disabled are allowed in Limited Areas, Secure Space and Transit/Buffer Space within buildings.

jobs.title: Model Evaluation Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Dyna Robotics** builds general-purpose robots powered by a proprietary embodied AI foundation model with top-in-industry generalization and real-world performance. Already deployed with customers across multiple industries, our robots do commercial-grade work in the physical world. Our team comes from Google DeepMind, Meta, and Cruise, and we're backed by CRV, First Round, and other leading investors.

**The Role**
============

Dyna Robotics is building general-purpose robots that perform useful work in real-world environments. We’re looking for a Model Evaluation Lead to lead the team responsible for understanding how our robot policies perform and whether new model versions deliver meaningful improvements.

You’ll manage and develop the evaluation team, own evaluation planning and execution, and work closely with researchers to define what we test, how we measure it, and what we learn. This is a hands-on leadership role combining people management, experimental rigor, and technical judgment. Your work will help researchers understand model behavior, prioritize improvements, and assess readiness for deployment.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* **Manage work flows for the evaluation team.** Manage the team’s priorities. Establish clear ownership, provide regular coaching and feedback, and build onboarding and training practices that help team members execute evaluations and investigate issues independently.
* **Work closely with researchers.** Translate research questions into evaluation plans with clear hypotheses, success criteria, and deliverables. Partner with researchers to compare model checkpoints, assess new capabilities, and balance recurring evaluations with urgent experiments and available robot capacity.
* **Design meaningful evaluations.** Develop task definitions, scoring rubrics, and test scenarios that reflect real operating conditions. Measure task success, output quality, cycle time, human interventions, and recovery behavior. Choose appropriate trial counts and account for variability when interpreting results.
* **Make results repeatable and trustworthy.** Standardize setup, resets, scoring, and intervention rules. Ensure results are traceable to model versions, robot configurations, test conditions, logs, and videos. Coordinate with hardware and operations partners to resolve issues that affect evaluation quality.
* **Turn failures into actionable findings.** Review robot behavior, logs, and video with the team and researchers. Distinguish model failures from hardware, software, setup, or execution issues. Identify recurring failure patterns and recommend focused investigations, additional data collection, or annotation improvements.
* **Own regression coverage and reporting.** Maintain consistent benchmarks and held-out test scenarios across tasks and conditions. Identify regressions, track progress across model versions, and communicate what improved, what remains unreliable, and where evidence is still limited. Provide clear recommendations that inform deployment decisions.
* **Improve evaluation tools and workflows.** Use data analysis and lightweight scripting to improve reporting and reduce manual work. Partner with engineering on evaluation tooling, automation, and dashboards. Shorten the time from a new checkpoint to useful findings while preserving the quality of the evidence.

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

* Experience in robotics, machine learning, applied research, or model evaluation, with direct ownership of evaluation design and analysis.
* Demonstrated experience managing and developing a technical team, including setting priorities, giving feedback, and building effective working practices.
* Strong experimental judgment: you can define success, control relevant variables, identify gaps in test coverage, and assess whether an apparent improvement is meaningful.
* Technical fluency to work directly with researchers on model checkpoints, generalization, data quality, and experimental tradeoffs.
* Comfort using Python or similar tools to analyze results, inspect logs, and improve evaluation workflows.
* Clear communication and strong ownership. You can turn an ambiguous request into an executable plan, surface problems early, and explain findings to both research and operations teams.

**Bonus Points For**
====================

* Evaluating robot manipulation policies, embodied AI, autonomous systems, or other machine learning systems operating in the physical world.
* Building regression suites, benchmark datasets, failure taxonomies, or evaluation tools, and connecting findings to model development or deployment readiness.

*At* ***Dyna Robotics****, we build technology for the real world, which requires a team as diverse as the environments our robots inhabit. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to technical rigor and mutual respect.*

***Don’t let a checklist stop you.*** *Data shows that underrepresented groups often only apply if they meet 100% of the criteria. We value problem-solving and grit over keyword matching. If you’re passionate about robotics, no matter your discipline, we want to hear from you, even if you don't check every box.*

Compensation Range: $140K - $160K

Responsibilities
  
  
The Global Business Marketing (GBM) team champions TikTok in the B2B landscape, showing advertisers and sales teams how TikTok's creative ecosystem drives real business results. We build the stories, education, and go-to-market programs that sellers use to deepen client relationships across markets. Working with brands of all sizes, we also bring campaigns to life through creative ideation, brand and event strategy, and the design and production of TikTok for Business marketing, so advertisers can create content that connect with audiences. Trends, consumer behavior, and advertising formats all move quickly on TikTok. The challenge is turning what makes the platform engaging into solutions that are creative, measurable, and scalable across very different markets, without making the experience feel like traditional advertising. You will shape how the market understands TikTok as a business platform, and help brands show up authentically on it. Our Product MarComs (PMC) & Industry Enablement (IE) sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, Data and Customer Experience. We build the knowledge, education, intelligence and measurement capabilities that help turn product innovation and marketing interventions into measurable customer and business outcomes. Our work spans customer and seller experiences including the Business Resource Center, in-product education, sales enablement and AI-powered education experiences. As these experiences become increasingly connected, our measurement approach must evolve as well—from measuring individual programs and channels to understanding how knowledge, education and marketing interventions influence customer behavior across the journey. We are building a measurement and experimentation capability that connects customer engagement to activation, product adoption, expansion and business growth. We're seeking an experienced Program Manager, Measurement & Experimentation to build the measurement foundation that enables data-driven decision making across product knowledge, education and customer enablement experiences. Today, customer and seller interactions occur across multiple surfaces and systems. Traffic, engagement, learning activity, AI interactions, product behavior and commercial outcomes are often measured independently, making it difficult to understand the complete customer journey or determine which interventions actually drive behavior. This role will help change that. Responsibilities Build a Connected Measurement Architecture - Develop scalable measurement frameworks to evaluate the business impact of product knowledge, education, and enablement initiatives across the customer journey. - Define standardized metrics, event taxonomies, and measurement requirements across reach, engagement, learning, activation, product adoption, and commercial outcomes. - Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, and Analytics teams to integrate data across systems, improve measurement capabilities, and connect customer engagement to downstream business outcomes. Connect Engagement to Business Outcomes - Develop measurement frameworks that connect customer and seller engagement to measurable behavioral and business outcomes beyond traditional engagement metrics. - Define leading and lagging indicators to assess the impact of knowledge and education initiatives on activation, product adoption, retention, expansion, and revenue. - Establish attribution and measurement approaches to evaluate the effectiveness and business contribution of educational experiences and platforms, such as TikTok Academy and Business Help Center. Build an Experimentation Capability - Establish scalable experimentation standards and playbooks across knowledge, education, and customer enablement programs. - Partner with Product, Marketing, and Data Science teams to design and evaluate experiments using clear hypotheses, success metrics, and appropriate testing methodologies. - Translate experimental insights into actionable recommendations to optimize customer behavior, product experiences, content, and engagement strategies. Develop Holistic Reporting & Decision Systems - Develop scalable reporting frameworks, datasets, and dashboards that provide end-to-end visibility across the customer journey and business outcomes. - Create executive-level insights, performance benchmarks, and automated monitoring to identify trends, gaps, and optimization opportunities. - Partner with Analytics and Data Engineering teams to translate data into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions and continuous improvement. Enable Customer and Knowledge Intelligence - Leverage behavioral data across customer interactions, learning, AI experiences, and product usage to identify knowledge gaps and adoption barriers. - Partner with cross-functional teams to identify customer friction and determine effective interventions across audiences, products, and journey stages. - Establish continuous feedback loops that translate measurement insights into actionable improvements for knowledge, education, customer adoption, and GTM strategies. Connect Measurement to GBM Objectives Develop measurement approaches that demonstrate how our capabilities contribute to GBM priorities including: - New Client Acquisition: qualification, onboarding, activation and time to first meaningful action. - Client Expansion: adoption of additional products and capabilities, engagement and growth. - Product Growth: product awareness → understanding → activation → sustained adoption. - Market Positioning: reach, engagement and behavioral signals associated with strategic narratives and education. - Commercial Marketing Excellence: measurement consistency, automation, experimentation and decision quality.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (Digital Health & Pharmacy)
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
Develop Health is on a mission to use AI to radically accelerate access to life-saving medications. By automating complex, manual healthcare processes—like benefit verification and prior authorization— **we've been growing rapidly and over the past couple of years have helped over 3.6 million patients!**

We’re partnering with some of the largest pharmacy benefit managers and payers in the nation, revolutionizing how healthcare interactions occur by eliminating human delays and inefficiencies. Our small, elite team of founders and engineers have previously launched and exited successful healthcare startups including Rupa Health and Canvas Medical. We are now scaling rapidly following a major funding round.

**About The Role**
------------------

We're hiring a **Customer Success Manager** to own a book of digital health and pharmacy accounts after they sign.

This role doesn't carry a quota. You're measured on retention, renewals, and volume growth from your accounts, and you'll work closely with product and engineering.

Day to day, you'll learn each customer's goals and follow through on what you commit to. You'll watch usage and support data to catch problems early, and bring forward places where customers could send us more volume.

Candidates from outside healthcare are welcome. You'll need to learn a complex domain quickly.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Own a book of accounts**

* Be the main post-sale contact for a set of digital health and pharmacy customers.
* Agree on success criteria with each account and track them.
* Run regular check-ins and business reviews using our templates, and improve them as you go.

**Protect and grow revenue**

* Watch account health and act on early signs of trouble.
* Support renewals and flag expansion opportunities to the team.

**Be the customer's voice inside Develop Health**

* Bring feedback and recurring issues to product and engineering, with examples.
* Resolve customer issues end to end, and escalate the complex ones with the right context.

**What You'll Bring On Day 1**
------------------------------

* **3+ years in a post-sale, account-owning role** (Customer Success, Account Management) with named accounts.
* **Outcomes you can point to**. Renewals, saves, or growth on accounts you owned.
* **B2B experience.** Your customers were companies.
* **Follow-through.** You track what you owe people and close the loop without being chased.
* **Comfort with data.** You can read a dashboard and explain what changed.

**What You'll Need To Learn Quickly**
-------------------------------------

* **Our domain:** prior authorization, benefit verification, PBMs and payers, and why they matter to our customers.
* **Our customers' businesses:** how a telehealth company or a pharmacy works day to day.
* **Our product:** what it does, and how to explain it plainly.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Account management at a health-tech company, a pharmacy, or a pharma services company.
* Pharmacy tech (CPhT) or pharmacy operations experience in a customer-facing role.
* Supported high-volume or integration-heavy customers (APIs, EHRs).
* Experience at an early-stage startup.
* Experience with CS tools (Pylon, Gainsight, Vitally).

**This Might Not Be The Right Fit If**
--------------------------------------

* **You want a quota.** New logos belong to our sales team.
* **You prefer working a support queue.** You'll solve customer issues end to end, and you'll also own account health and support renewals.
* **You want to manage people right away.** This is an individual contributor role.
* **You need a lot of structure.** Helping build it is part of the job.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base salary plus meaningful early-stage equity.
* Health, dental, and vision coverage, 401k matching, plus flexible PTO.
* A clear path to a strategic book of accounts as we grow.
* Work that directly speeds up access to medication for hundreds of thousands of patients.

Compensation Range: $140K - $160K

**About the role and team**  
  
Working as a Sr. Customer Success Manager at Uber means moving beyond the polished surface of account management to solve the complex, high-stakes operational realities our largest enterprise partners face every day. You will be the bridge between our digital platform and the physical storefronts of our most important enterprise partners, ensuring that Uber remains their preferred delivery engine through relentless analytical rigor and hands-on problem solving.

* Experience in the technology or food delivery industry managing high-pressure projects.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager I
jobs.description:
### **The Role**

You'll partner with plaintiff U.S. law firms, from small and mid-market practices to select enterprise accounts, to drive software adoption, retention, and account growth. In this role, you'll act as a strategic advisor and change management partner, helping legal teams transform their workflows and leverage our platform—including generative AI capabilities—to achieve meaningful business outcomes on their most critical matters.

**This is a full-time, exempt position based in our New York City, NY or Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.**

What you'll do

* Own retention and growth across your book of business, driving renewals and identifying opportunities to expand usage
* Build multi-threaded relationships across law firm stakeholders, including day-to-day users, administrators, practice group leaders, and executive sponsors.
* Conduct regular check-in calls, strategic success reviews, and product demonstrations centered on usage data, business impact, and strategic alignment.
* Teach customers how to use platform features and workflows effectively, guiding them on best practices for adopting generative AI capabilities.
* Proactively identify retention risks, solve complex workflow challenges, and partner closely with Sales, User Education, Product, and Support to deliver a seamless customer experience.
* Share customer feedback, document best practices, and contribute to the continuous improvement of the Customer Success team.

About You

* You have at least 4 years of customer success experience managing a large book of mid-market and enterprise accounts within SaaS or consumption-based technology companies.
* You act as a strategic advisor and change management partner, using workflow expertise and data-driven account plans to influence customer behavior and drive adoption.
* You navigate complex client organizations effectively, building credibility, trust, and strong executive presence with senior leadership.
* You manage competing priorities proactively and possess exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* You are authorized to work in the United States. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring U.S. employment visas for this role.

Bonus points

* Experience in legal tech, litigation software consulting, or related legal industry workflows.
* Experience working with AI tools (Claude, Glean, etc.) to optimize your day-to-day responsibilities

Think you're missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that's a better fit.

### **The Team — Customer Success**

The Customer Success team helps customers turn Everlaw's powerful technology into meaningful outcomes on their most important matters. As trusted advisors, the team builds lasting partnerships, guides adoption, and helps organizations integrate Everlaw into the way they work. By connecting customer priorities and feedback with teams across Everlaw, Customer Success helps customers realize sustained value while strengthening the relationships that drive retention and growth.

### **Total Rewards & Benefits**

The annual base salary for this position is between $116,000 - $148,000, with a total On-Target Earnings (OTE) of between $145,000 - $185,000, representing a 80/20 compensation split. Eligibility for the commission portion is performance-based and subject to the achievement of specific performance metrics, which are governed by Everlaw's policies and incentive plans. The final offered salary will be dependent upon many factors including the candidate's experience and skills. The role's compensation is subject to change in the future.

Health & well-being

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses
* Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness
* Paid parental leave
* Company-sponsored life and disability insurance

Financial rewards

* Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw's long-term growth
* 401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation

Growth & everyday perks

* 17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave
* Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company-wide days off) per year
* Annual allocation for learning & development and relevant professional membership dues
* Hybrid work with regular work-from-home days and flexibility for life's logistics
* Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup
* Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company-wide events in our offices

About Everlaw When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence — emails, documents, chats, files — to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of messy data into the handful of facts that win or lose a case, compressing weeks of work into hours.

We're the kind of place that's ranked #1 on G2 in our category and named a Great Place to Work™ by our own team. So if you want a front row seat to an industry in transformation, career-defining work you'll be proud to tell people about, and real upside at a company in control of its own destiny, we'd love to get to know you.

* #LI-KV1
* #LI-Hybrid

About Everlaw

*At Everlaw, you'll shape how AI re-wires the legal industry, at a category-leading business built on a mission to illuminate the truth.*

Everlaw is an equal opportunity employer. We pride ourselves on having a diverse workforce and we do not discriminate against any employee

jobs.title: Plan Associate II & Office Manager (San Francisco, CA)
jobs.description:
**Plan Associate II & Office Manager (San Francisco, CA)**

**Summary -** Serving as the face of BeneSys at a client level, the **Plan Associate II** position is responsible for working alongside Plan Management to administer various employee benefit plans including, Health & Welfare, Pension, Vacation, Apprenticeship and Supplemental Unemployment Benefit Funds. This position serves as the **Office Manager** for the San Francisco office. The position is considered “exempt” under the Fair Labor Standards Act.

**Plan Associate II Essential Duties and Responsibilities include but not limited to**

* Ability to take full responsibility for a Fund and/or Client.
* Exercise discretion and confidentiality in matters relating to administration of employee benefit plans.
* Prepare for and present at participant meetings and health fairs.
* Respond to participant appeals.
* Create and maintain Barometers and other meeting reports.
* Calculate PBGC premiums.
* Timely review and process Trustee expense reports and payroll reimbursements.
* Manage government audit process and coordinate payroll audits. Complete all other audits independently and in time.
* Prepare month-end reports.
* Answer questions from vendors, professionals and legal counsel without supervision and using sound judgment and solid problem-solving skills.
* Assist Coordinators in resolving participant inquiries, including by prioritizing requests and materials and determining which inquiries to escalate.
* Respond to inquiries by Trustees and Service Providers and address other escalated calls or situations.
* Have working knowledge of Plan documents, Summary Plan Descriptions and Trust documents and policies.
* With respect to Board of Trustees Meetings: (1) schedule and coordinate meetings; (2)attend meetings, record actions taken, and prepare meeting minutes, using discretion and knowledge of Plan documents to determine noteworthy items; (3) present orally, including as the lead presenter (4) prepare and distribute a post-meeting task list, schedule meetings to discuss the task list and follow up with Plan Professionals and BeneSys department staff to ensure completion of action items; (5) some overnight travel may be necessary.
* Review and analyze monthly financial statements, work-hour reports and participant counts, and monitor income and expense fluctuations.
* Trouble-shoot issues to ensure that client-specific procedures are understood, correctly implemented, and routinely followed.
* Draft participant communications.
* Compile data needed for annual health and pension plan valuations.
* Exercise discretion and confidentiality in matters relating to administration of employee benefit plans.
* Compile meeting booklets, reviewing for accuracy, and proper grammar and format.
* Provide governing documents to new Trustees.
* Maintain a current Trustee and Service Provider roster, acceptance and termination of Trusteeship documents.
* Schedule guests and vendors for Trust meetings and prepare timely Trustee meeting notifications.
* Maintain documents on Trustee, Client, and Participant Sites, ensuring Plan Documents, SPD’s, amendment, participant notices and plan changes are current.
* Assist in preparation of Form 5500 and with Fund audits.
* Prepare monthly ad-hoc reports for Trustees and Local Union Office.
* Review and process all invoices.
* Set up and maintain administrative paper and electronic files. including maintaining meeting files.
* Prepare participant, contractor, and Trustee mailings.
* Timely direct subpoenas, Medicare notices, and other notices to the departments for handling
* Regular and predictable attendance is an essential function of this job.
* Duties may vary depending on individual Fund staffing.

**Office Manager Essential Duties and Responsibilities include but not limited to**

* Work with vendors regarding all office needs.
* Compiling the supply list monthly and submit order by the 15th and 30th of each month.
* Work with IT department for any office needs.
* Liaison between Property Management & Office.
* Partner with HR to ensure all BeneSys rules/procedures are followed.
* Assign and track all keycards and fobs to the office.
* Conduct HIPAA quarterly desk audits.
* Maintain bulletin boards in kitchen/breakroom.
* UPS and postage report, weekly/monthly.
* Plan and organize office events within the approved budget.

**Education and/or Experience -** High school diploma or GED equivalent. College degree preferred. Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office suite of applications, including Word, Outlook and Excel.

**Language Skills -** Ability to read, analyze and interpret general correspondence. Ability to prepare reports, draft meeting minutes and correspond with Fund vendors, participants and Trustees. Ability to effectively present information and respond to inquiries from managers, clients, vendors and participants. Strong writing and editing skills are a must.

**Reasoning Skills -** Ability to interpret and follow a variety of instructions furnished in written or oral form. Must be attentive to detail and disciplined in meeting deadlines and setting priorities.

**Math Skills -** Capable of applying intermediate level math skills, including concepts of fractions, percentages and decimals, in addition to basic concepts of addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.

**Physical Demands -** Position requires the ability to travel to offsite locations to attend Trustee meetings. There may be some occasional light lifting and require some periods of sustained keyboarding. Position requires use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, label printers, filing cabinets, fax machines, etc.

**Work Schedule** - Full time. Monday – Friday, 7:30am - 4:00pm. Required in office (no at-home days).  
  
**Competitive Benefits and Compensation Package**

* Vacation days earned at a rate of 1 day per each full month worked (for your first pro-rated year)
* 12 paid holi
