jobs.title: Revenue Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

You will be the second person on Revenue Operations, reporting directly to the Director of RevOps and working as his right hand. RevOps at Outset owns the full go-to-market stack and the numbers that run the business: Salesforce, HubSpot, routing, automations, ARR reporting, quota and comp tracking, sales process and policy. Today one person runs all of it, with AI tools doing a lot of the heavy lifting. Your job is to take real ownership of a growing share of that scope, fast.  
  
**Responsibilities**  
  
*Systems and CRM*

* Administer Salesforce day to day: fields, record types, page layouts, permission sets, validation rules, flows, reports and dashboards.
* Keep the HubSpot Salesforce sync healthy, debug field and picklist mismatches, and own lead-to-opportunity data integrity.
* Maintain and extend our sales tool stack: Apollo, Momentum (call recording), LinkedIn Sales Navigator, meeting routing, Linear, Slack bots.
* Run user provisioning, onboarding and offboarding across the stack, and keep the integration users and connections tidy.

*Automation and AI*

* Build and maintain workflows in n8n that connect Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Linear and Google Workspace.
* Use Claude and other AI tools as a default working style: drafting SOQL and flows, writing runbooks, summarizing calls, prepping handover docs, pressure-testing analyses.
* Spot manual, repetitive work on the GTM team and remove it.

*Analytics and reporting*

* Own recurring reporting: weekly revenue breakouts, pipeline and stage hygiene, AE quota attainment and ramp, win/loss by segment and competitor.
* Keep ARR truth clean: reconcile ARR by contract, maintain customer and account-status definitions in Salesforce, and make sure nothing is double counted.
* Build dashboards leadership actually uses, in Salesforce, Google Sheets, or whatever tool fits, and be able to explain every number on them.
* Answer ad hoc questions from the CRO, finance and the board with fast, correct, well-caveated analysis.

*Sales process and enablement*

* Run pipeline hygiene: stale-opportunity nudges, stage definitions, close-date discipline, the Sales CS handover.
* Help draft and roll out sales policy such as Rules of Engagement, territory and lead routing, and comp plan mechanics, then enforce them in the system.
* Support deal desk work: order forms, pricing and discount checks, contract term extraction into Salesforce.
* Be the first call for AEs and SDRs when something in the stack is broken or confusing, and fix it or teach it.

**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or an adjacent seat at a B2B SaaS company (sales ops analyst, SDR or AE who moved into ops, BizOps, CS ops).
* Hands-on Salesforce experience: you have built reports and dashboards, edited fields and layouts, and ideally written a flow or two. Admin certification is a plus, not a requirement.
* Working knowledge of a B2B sales motion end to end: lead sources, SDR qualification, stages, pilots and POCs, closed-won, renewals and expansion. You understand what an AE’s week looks like and what makes their life harder.
* AI tools as a native part of how you work. You already use Claude, ChatGPT or similar to write queries, draft documents, debug formulas and think through problems, and you can tell when the output is wrong.
* Strong spreadsheet and data skills: lookups, pivots, clean data models, and the judgment to know when a number does not smell right.
* Clear written communication. A lot of this job is explaining a system, a policy or a number to a salesperson in a Slack message.

**Nice to have**

* HubSpot (marketing hub or CRM) and experience with a HubSpot Salesforce sync.
* Time carrying a quota, or sitting next to people who do.
* Experience with deal desk, order forms or contract review.
* Exposure to ARR accounting concepts: new, expansion, contraction, churn, contracted vs. invoiced.
* Scrappy and resourceful: you would rather ship a good-enough fix today and improve it next week than wait for a perfect spec.
* A jack of all trades who is happy to go from a permission-set bug to a board-deck chart to a rep’s comp question in the same afternoon.
* Eager to learn and quick to pick things up; you ask good questions, take notes, and do not need to be told twice.
* High ownership. When something is yours, it gets done and it gets done right.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and with being the one who brings structure to it.

Compensation Range: $125K - $150K

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager

The role is accountable for the identification and development of new partnerships while managing and strengthening existing relationships. jobs.description:
**About 1nHealth, Inc.**  
1nHealth is a software-centric patient recruitment company for the clinical research industry. We exist to fill studies, connecting patients with research. We have been active for 6 years as a bootstrapped startup that now has 45 employees and multiple clients in top Pharma, leading biotechnology companies, and many of the top Contract Research Organizations (CROs) in the space. Our mission is to advance human health and make a positive impact on patients, clients, and our team members all over the world.

We are growing and profitable. Our company is a client and employee centric meritocracy. If you're ready to be part of a team of highly intelligent professionals using technology for good, come join us at 1nHealth.

**About the role**

The Patient Coordinator (PC) Support Lead is a senior individual contributor role that combines the full responsibilities of a Patient Coordinator with a leadership layer: overseeing, coaching, and managing the performance of 1nHealth's contractor (vendor) PC team. This role is ideal for an experienced Patient Coordinator who demonstrates strong clinical knowledge, communication excellence, and the desire to develop and elevate others.

The PC Support Lead plays a critical dual role — remaining an active contributor in the pre-screening process while ensuring the contractor PC team meets quality standards, performance metrics, and compliance requirements.

**Duties and Responsibilities**  
  
**Patient Coordinator Duties**

* **Pre-Screening Calls:** Manage a high volume of inbound and outbound calls. Conduct thorough pre-screening calls with potential candidates remotely to gather medical history, demographics, and other relevant information as per trial protocols.
* **Patient Interaction:** Communicate clearly and compassionately with potential participants, explaining the purpose of clinical trials, eligibility criteria, and associated risks or benefits. Forge relationships with patients by going the extra mile.
* **Medical Terminology:** Demonstrate proficiency in medical terminology to accurately assess patient information and determine eligibility for clinical trials.
* **Technical Skills:** Utilize remote communication tools including Microsoft Outlook, SharePoint, RingCentral, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and other relevant software for conducting calls, documentation, and team communication.
* **Performance Metrics:** Meet or exceed KPIs related to pre-qualified referrals and downstream funnel outcomes such as enrollment rates and conversion ratios.
* **Documentation:** Maintain detailed and accurate records of patient interactions using remote documentation tools, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and trial-specific requirements.
* **Quality Assurance:** Adhere to established quality assurance protocols to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and trial-specific requirements.
* **Training and Development:** Participate in ongoing remote training sessions to stay updated on trial protocols, regulatory requirements, and best practices in patient engagement.
* **Communication:** Provide timely updates to relevant stakeholders regarding patient status, referral outcomes, and any issues or concerns that may arise during the pre-screening process.

**Contractor Team Oversight & Coaching**

* **Call Quality Review (QA):** Regularly review recorded calls from contractor PCs to evaluate adherence to scripts, regulatory requirements, and 1nHealth quality standards. Document findings and use them to inform coaching sessions.
* **KPI Dashboard Review:** Monitor the PC KPI dashboard on an ongoing basis to assess individual and team-level performance metrics. Proactively identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement across the contractor team.
* **Coaching & Feedback Delivery:** Provide structured, constructive coaching to each direct report on the contractor PC team, including:
* Delivering meaningful, individualized feedback to each direct report a minimum of twice per month.
* Escalating unresolved performance concerns to the PC Team Lead when coaching alone does not produce the necessary improvement.
* **Performance-Based Bonus Recommendations:** Evaluate contractor PC performance data and provide informed recommendations to the PC Team Lead regarding which team members should be considered for performance-based bonuses.
* **Timesheet Approval:** Review and approve contractor PC timesheets on a weekly basis, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
* **Monthly Invoice Generation:** Compile and generate the monthly invoice for contractor hours. Deliver the completed invoice to the PC Team Lead for review and approval in a timely manner.
* **Process Improvement:** Collaborate with the PC Team Lead and Enrollment Operations Manager to identify opportunities for, and actively contribute to, the development and implementation of process improvements within the PC department.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 3 years of experience in a call center environment, with at least 1 year in a within the healthcare or clinical research industry patient-facing screening role.
* Prior supervisory, coaching, or team lead experience strongly preferred.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey complex medical information clearly and effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver constructive feedback in a professional, empathetic, and results-oriented manner.
* Proficiency in remote communication and productivity tools including RingCentral, Slack, and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Solid knowledge of medical terminology and clinical trial processes.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize workload, and manage competing responsibilities in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and comfort with data-driven performance management.
* GCP (Good Clinical Practice) certification or willingness to obtain certification within a specified timeframe.

Success in this role will be measured by reductions in open client hours and unmet service needs, improved staffing efficiency and caregiver utilization, stronger alignment between workforce supply and client demand, and consistent execution of staffing processes across markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Staffing Liaisons responsible for matching caregivers with client needs and supporting continuity of services across multiple states.

* Establish clear performance expectations and accountability measures for the Staffing Liaison team.

* Identify process inefficiencies and lead operational improvement initiatives that increase productivity, consistency, scalability, and service delivery performance.

* Ensure consistent processes, system utilization, and documentation standards across regions.

* Support strategic initiatives related to organizational growth, workforce planning, capacity forecasting, recruiting strategy, and operational excellence.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated success leading teams against measurable performance goals, KPIs, and accountability standards.

* Experience with workforce planning, staffing optimization, scheduling, recruiting, capacity management, or workforce deployment.

jobs.title: Utilities Infrastructure Project Manager (Wastewater)
jobs.description:
The Utilities Infrastructure Project Manager (Wastewater) delivers Havenpark’s wastewater infrastructure projects, including wastewater treatment plants, collection systems, tanks, and drainage, on budget and by the budgeted completion dates. The role owns each assigned project from scope definition through closeout, managing the engineers and contractors to completion. The wastewater portfolio currently includes about 53 open projects totaling $9.5 million.

This role is accountable for completion. Community managers and Regional Vice Presidents (RVP) stay informed and partner on access and communication, but they are not responsible for finishing the work. The Sr. Utilities Program Manager sets priorities and selects projects and also owns compliance, operators, and utility emergency response, so this role can stay focused on projects.

On critical projects and others that need an engineer for design and construction, the position manages the engineers and holds them to scope, schedule, and cost. It reinforces Havenpark’s values and purpose-driven culture of creating caring communities.

### **Project Planning & Delivery**

* Own a portfolio of wastewater projects from scope definition through closeout, finishing each on budget and on schedule, with no projects past due.
* Define scope fully before bidding, including what is and is not included, so contractors price and plan the real work and change requests are rare.
* Build the plan up front: lead times, agency review times, access and seasonal constraints, and potential start delays. Start early enough to finish on time.
* Maintain project plans, milestones, and budgeted completion dates in project management software; flag risks early and recover projects that go past due.
* Visit project sites as needed, and verify that work is actually complete and ready before marking a project complete.
* Close out projects with final documentation, as-builts, warranties, and lessons learned.

### **Contractor & Engineer Management**

* Manage engineers and contractors to completion on every assigned project, holding them accountable for quality, safety, schedule, and cost.
* Walk contractors through the scope and schedule before they start and confirm their understanding in writing; manage bids, contracts, and change orders; and compare change requests against the survey, scope, and drawings before approving.
* Engage engineers for design and construction on critical projects and other projects that require engineering; define their scopes of work, review designs and cost estimates, and review invoices and progress reports.
* Select and develop a reliable bench of contractors in the assigned region and replace those who do not perform, with documented reasons.

### **Permitting & Regulatory Coordination**

* Coordinate wastewater project permits, plan reviews, and approvals with state agencies and local authorities, in partnership with the Sr. Utilities Program Manager.
* Build agency review time into every plan, respond quickly to agency comments, and confirm approvals and conditions are cleared before work starts.
* Ensure projects are built and documented to meet regulatory requirements, and hand off completed systems and documentation to the Sr. Utilities Program Manager for ongoing compliance.

### **Budget, Cost Control & Reporting**

* Develop project budgets and cost forecasts; track actual costs against the budget and report variances early.
* Report project status, past-due projects, risks, and needed decisions to the VP of Capital Projects and the Sr. Utilities Program Manager on an agreed cadence.
* Support annual utility budget planning with project scopes and cost estimates.

### **Collaboration & Business Partnership**

* Keep community managers and RVPs informed about schedules, access, and anything that affects their communities, serving as a single point of contact so they don't have to field calls from multiple parties.
* Partner with the Sr. Utilities Program Manager on project priorities, sequencing, and capital needs identified through system health and compliance findings.
* Stay on the shared outage communication thread and assist as needed; the Sr. Utilities Program Manager leads utility emergency response.
* Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and care consistent with Havenpark’s purpose of creating caring communities.

### **Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in engineering, environmental science, or a related field preferred.
* **Experience:** 3-5 years managing utility infrastructure projects, specifically wastewater.
* **Certification:** Project Management Professional (PMP) preferred, not required.
* **Skills & Knowledge:**
* Wastewater treatment, collection, tank, and drainage project delivery, from design through construction and closeout
* Wastewater regulations, agency plan review, and permitting
* Construction contracts, bidding, change orders, and vendor management
* Project budgeting, forecasting, and cost tracking
* Project management software and scheduling tools
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Self-motivated, organized problem solver able to manage multiple projects and priorities independently
* High learning agility; works well with all levels of the organization and is a strong team player
* **Physical Demands & Additional Requirements**

  Primarily an office-based position with typical physical demands related to extended computer and phone use, including long periods of sitting, and periods of walking and standing at project sites in outdoor conditions. Travel is expected about once per quarter to visit large projects, with occasional additional travel for meetings.

  Able to pass a criminal background check.

jobs.description:
The Business Solutions Manager is responsible for coordinating and advancing business and technology initiatives across the Contact Center & Communications Technology portfolio within RoundPoint’s Customer Experience & Technology organization. This role serves as a central point of coordination across business operations, product management, technology, and other enterprise teams to ensure initiatives are aligned, dependencies are managed, and solutions advance effectively.
  
Working closely with business leaders, product managers, technical leads, compliance and cross-functional stakeholders, the Business Solutions Manager translates broader business priorities into coordinated execution plans. This includes facilitating alignment, identifying risks and dependencies, tracking progress, and ensuring teams have the information, resources, and decisions needed to advance initiatives.
  
The Business Solutions Manager also evaluates the effectiveness of initiatives, business processes, and technology capabilities across the portfolio; identifies gaps and opportunities for improvement; and helps inform future priorities. This role supports the continued evolution of contact center capabilities and customer communications, ensuring technology investments and business initiatives advance operational effectiveness, customer experience, and enterprise objectives.
  
  
Responsibilities
  

* Portfolio Coordination: Own cross-functional initiatives across the Contact Center Technology and Communications portfolio, ensuring business, technology, operational, and enterprise stakeholders remain aligned on priorities, timelines, deliverables, and expected outcomes.
* Cross-Functional Execution: Serve as the owner and central coordination point for initiatives spanning multiple teams, facilitating collaboration and ensuring each group understands its responsibilities, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Initiative Planning and Oversight: Develop and maintain coordinated execution plans for key initiatives, tracking milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and progress from initial planning through implementation.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Lead discussions among business leaders, product managers, technical leads, IT, operations, compliance, legal, and other stakeholders to align expectations, resolve issues, and maintain forward momentum.
* Risk and Dependency Management: Proactively identify cross-functional risks, resource constraints, competing priorities, and dependencies that may affect delivery. Coordinate mitigation efforts and escalate issues requiring leadership decisions.
* Product and Technology Partnership: Partner with product managers and technical leads to coordinate initiatives across requirements, development, testing, deployment, and post-implementation activities while maintaining clear ownership of product requirements and technical delivery.
* Portfolio Effectiveness and Continuous Improvement: Evaluate the effectiveness of initiatives, business processes, and technology capabilities across the portfolio to assess alignment with business objectives, operational needs, and customer experience goals. Identify gaps, emerging needs, performance concerns, and opportunities for improvement, partnering with product management, technology, and business stakeholders to determine appropriate solutions and next steps.
* Opportunity Identification and Portfolio Evolution: Proactively identify and evaluate opportunities to enhance existing capabilities, improve operational efficiency, address business needs, and strengthen the customer experience. VEC is a leading construction technology services provider that is at the forefront of innovation in the construction industry, delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that revolutionize the way construction projects are designed and built. This role may be hired at the Manager or Senior Manager level, depending on experience and qualifications, and is responsible for establishing and overseeing BIM/VDC program requirements for owner-driven projects. The role defines program frameworks, sets digital delivery standards, and coordinates across design and construction stakeholders to ensure consistent, predictable digital delivery aligned with owner expectations across projects and phases.

**Program Setup & Governance**

**Summary of Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

Transition Phase (usually 90-120 days)

While permanent staff are being hired and onboarded, this position will serve as a member of the QuickStart Team to immediately begin work for the new CBL client.

At the immediate startup of a CBL, the CBL Project Manager will triage the incoming work to determine whether the instrument will be calibrated at the CBL, sent to another Transcat lab, or sent to an approved supplier. They will also perform calibrations through direct calibration of the instruments at the CBL or by performing the review of vendor calibration certs to complete those work orders. As the permanent technician(s) for the CBL are hired, onboarded, and ramp up their calibration duties, the CBL Project Managers will ramp down their direct calibration work and start training and supervising the permanent calibration technicians’ work. Over the course of each Transition Phase, the Project Manager’s calibration tasks start at 100% of their time and reduce to less than 10% over the Phase. In any given year, the calibration tasks equate to about one-third of a Project Manager’s time.

Steady-State Phase

Once the CBL reaches Steady-State, the Project Manager will perform data reviews of technicians’ work across multiple CBLs, remotely, to assist the Calibration Operations Managers with that supervisory function.

In addition, during the Steady-State phase, the Project Manager will move on to the next CBL startup (a Transition Phase at a new CBL), while still performing data reviews of the technicians’ work across multiple CBLs. In addition, whenever technician turnover occurs at a CBL, the Project Manager will also fill in to complete the calibration work, ramping down as the replacement technician is hired/onboarded as described above.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Plan and controlling workflow to meet customer demands
* Provide ongoing technical assistance and direction to staff relative to Company’s services
* Establishing and maintaining positive customer and employee relations
* Establishing and maintaining teamwork within laboratory
* Assist in managing the handling of customer and/or employee issues
* Triage incoming equipment and assign work to technicians in the laboratory
* Track availability and updates records of lab assets
* Oversee, delegate, and/or initiate requests for data sheets for units for which a data sheet does not currently exist
* Assist CBL Operations Manager with training/onboarding of permanent CBL technician(s)
* Utilize various computerized maintenance management software (CMMS) and databases for instrument identification, calibration data entry and asset management
* Apply general knowledge and experience of instruments that measure: temperature, pressure, flow, force, torque, chemical analysis, optics, humidity, speed, viscosity, mechanical dimensions, geometric dimensioning & tolerancing (GD&T), vacuum, light intensity, mass, voltage, current, resistance and frequency
* Adapt to learn new instruments, calibration techniques, and develop skills to support requirements, including training of technicians
* As needed, perform calibration of electronic, electro-mechanical, analytical and mechanical instrumentation across a multitude of Metrology disciplines which may include but are not limited to:
  + Autoclaves, DI water systems, Lyophilizers and Wave Bioreactors
  + Analytical balances, centrifuges, freezers, refrigerators, stability chambers, incubators, ovens, ph meters, conductivity meters, monitoring systems, timers, stopwatches, thermometers, and glass washers, et.al.
  + Process controlled instruments in a factory/production environment using an understanding of the overall process, to identify key instruments, process tolerances, safety considerations, timelines and production schedules.
  + Electronic instruments using high-end standards: Multifunction calibrators, SPRT/RTDs, temperature baths, dry blocks, oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters, function generators, HiPot testers, timers
  + Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T): Custom gages using open-table setup, CMM, or Vision Sy

**Job Title: Senior Project Manager**  
**FLSA Status: Exempt**  
**Work Arrangement: Hybrid**

**WHO WE ARE:**

MGT is a leading provider of technology and advisory solutions serving state, local, and education government agencies (SLED) across the United States. Through client partnerships, MGT’s almost 1,200 employees impact communities for good by managing and securing critical networks, solving complex human capital and fiscal problems, elevating education systems, and advancing equity as a performance imperative. MGT partners with thousands of agencies as a trusted advisor delivering solutions that improve technology, operational, and economic performance to help communities thrive.

Founded in 1975, MGT initiated an ambitious restart in 2016, broadening the solutions portfolio to provide the most specialized solutions, tackling the most mission-critical problems that live at the top of the public agency leadership agenda. MGT drives over 20% compound annual organic growth and utilizes programmatic mergers and acquisitions to grow capabilities, attract top talent, and accelerate growth scale. Since 2020, MGT has successfully completed 13 acquisitions, driving over 60% compound annual inorganic growth.

Celebrating its 50th year in 2025, the firm attracts exceptional talent and empowers them to exceed client expectations as they navigate the dynamic demands of the clients we serve. Hear more about MGT’s culture in the words of our employees (https://www.mgt.us/careers/).

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

The Senior PM independently manages complex, multi-phase projects that may span both Engineering and Cabling solution groups, or technically specialized projects end-to-end. The Senior PM applies professional project management principles, practices, and techniques to lead project teams and control schedule, cost, and scope, while serving as the primary client relationship owner on assigned projects. This role monitors risk and issues to ensure client satisfaction and company profitability, and mentors Project Managers and Project Coordinators in the pool.

The Senior PM works closely with field Superintendents and subcontractors on cabling and low-voltage scope where applicable, coordinates services across departments, and may support workstreams under a Principal PM on large, multi-project accounts.

**Project Planning and Initiation**

* Independently manage complex, multi-phase projects across Engineering and Cabling solution groups, or technically specialized projects end-to-end.
* Serve as the primary client relationship owner on assigned projects.
* Develop comprehensive project plans using TSG tools and methodologies, defining scope, objectives, schedules, milestones, and risks.
* Have a thorough understanding of the scope for specific trades assigned and TSG's responsibilities regarding low-voltage systems and IT resources where applicable.

**Project Execution and Coordination**

* Manage scope, schedule, budget, change orders, and risk across the full project lifecycle.
* Coordinate across sales, engineering, and installation/cabling teams to secure resources and ensure alignment.
* Lead project governance meetings, generating agendas, minutes, and follow-ups.
* Work directly with field Superintendents and subcontractors to ensure timelines are met and communicate schedule changes to all relevant parties.
* Maintain and track project schedules using TSG's PMO processes and tools (Certinia, MS Project, Smartsheet), ensuring timely execution and issue resolution.
* Manage internal and external communications across all stakeholder levels; identify, document, and communicate project risks as they arise.

**Financial and Billing Management**

* Prepare, monitor, and manage project budgets, equipment inventories, and vendor/subcontractor relationships.
* Track project percent-complete and prepare progress or milestone billing per the statement of work.
* Coordinate material logistics, including procurement and chain-of-custody procedures.

**Project Closeout and Continuous Improvement**

* Perform quality assurance throughout the project lifecycle, including final inspection and punch list.
* Coordinate project closeout documentation (as-built drawings, O&Ms, test reports, warranty) and secure project sign-off.
* Evaluate and document lessons learned post-project to improve future performance.
* Mentor Project Managers and Project Coordinators; support workstreams under a Principal PM on large multi-project accounts.
* Assist PMO leadership in establishing, perfecting, and monitoring the efficiency of team processes and best practices.

**Performance Expectations**

* Sustains billable utilization at or above 80% on a trailing 90-day basis while managing complex, multi-phase project scope.
* Does whatever it takes to ensure projects are successful and profitable, including work beyond what is specifically outlined when required.
* Double-checks all critical work deliverables to minimize mistakes; continuously contributes to process improvements.
* Develops creative, win-win solutions to problems and identifies ways to deliver additional profit where possible.
* Completes all activities with a strong sense of ownership; demonstrates adherence to and performance in line with company goals.
* Actively participates in company-wide events, meetings, and social activities.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

May be assigned first-level supervisory or mentoring responsibilities for Project Managers and Project Coordinators, regionally or team-wide; no formal direct reports.

**Career Pathway**

Project Coordinator Project Manager Senior PM Program Manager. Each step adds complexity of scope, scale of account, and depth of independent client relationship ownership.

jobs.title: Regional Quality Manager
jobs.description:
At the interface of design, engineering and supply logistics, REHAU Automotive and SRG Global combine to form RESRG - a leading global supplier of coated exterior systems and components. With a combined track record of over 160 years across four continents and 22 production sites, RESRG's 10,000 skilled team members manufacture the latest exterior systems and components for the world's leading automotive manufacturers.
  
  
RESRG Automotive is seeking you to join our team as a Regional Quality Manager!
  
  
Your Job
  
The Regional Quality Manager is responsible for improving manufacturing quality performance across multiple plant locations. This is a hands-on, plant-facing role focused on establishing common quality standards, strengthening problem-solving capability, and driving sustainable improvements in scrap, waste, defects, and cost of poor quality.
  
The Quality Manager will work directly with plant Quality, Operations, Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to identify systemic issues, implement common processes, and build the capability of site teams to solve problems at the root cause.
  
This position will spend significant time within the manufacturing facilities, working alongside plant teams to improve processes and ensure successful practices are replicated across the region.
  
  
What You Will Do in Your Role
  

* Establish and deploy common quality standards and expectations across manufacturing locations.
* Identify best practices within individual plants and standardize them across the region.
* Improve consistency in quality processes, documentation, reporting, and manufacturing controls.
* Support compliance with IATF 16949, customer-specific requirements, and internal quality standards.
* Partner with plant leadership to identify quality risks and close systemic gaps.
* Build plant capability in structured problem-solving methodologies, including 8D, A3, 5 Why, Fishbone, and root cause analysis.
* Coach Quality Managers, Engineers, Operations leaders, and frontline teams on effective problem solving.
* Facilitate complex or recurring problem-solving activities when additional regional support is needed.
* Ensure corrective actions address true root causes and are sustained over time.
* Create mechanisms to share lessons learned and prevent repeat issues across facilities.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives to reduce scrap, rework, defects, waste, and Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ).
* Use quality and operational data to identify the largest opportunities for improvement.
* Support plant locations in developing measurable improvement plans and tracking results.
* Identify recurring issues across locations and drive regional countermeasures.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to eliminate quality-related process waste.
* Spend significant time at plant locations assessing processes and supporting improvement activity.
* Provide hands-on support for significant quality or manufacturing issues.
* Assist plants with customer complaints, containment, corrective actions, and systemic quality issues.
* Support APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA, and Layered Process Audits where needed.
* Help underperforming sites establish disciplined quality improvement plans.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or related field preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive quality experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Strong automotive manufacturing experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading structured problem-solving and continuous improvement activities.
* Strong working knowledge of IATF 16949 and automotive core tools, including APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, and MSA.
* Demonstrated ability to reduce scrap, defects, waste, and cost of poor quality.
* Ability to coach and influence plant teams without relying solely on direct reporting authority.
* Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.
* Ability to travel regularly among regional manufacturing facilities.

What Will Put You Ahead
  

* Experience supporting multiple manufacturing locations.
* Experience with injection molding, paint, plating, or automotive exterior components.
* Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, ASQ certification, or equivalent structured problem-solving experience.
* VDA 6.3 experience.

Our Benefits
  
Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.
  
  
Equal Opportunities
  
Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. This employer uses E-Verify.

* Act as a designated liaison with payer and managed care representatives to resolve recurring claim, reimbursement, and enrollment issues. Monitor membership additions and deletions and communicate discrepancies affecting billing.

jobs.description:
**Account Manager**  
REMOTE | US

**About Us**

Property Leads delivers high-quality, motivated seller leads to real estate investors, and we're expanding into home services. We're a quiet but mighty start-up that participated in 50% of off-market home sales in the last 12 months. We move fast, we're data-driven, and we care about results.

Our customers are real estate investors and roofers/roofing companies running real businesses on our leads. When something breaks for them, it matters, and fixing it fast is how we grow. If you want to check the box on responding to a ticket without solving the problem, this isn't the place. If you want to own real customer relationships and get on the phone to solve real problems, it is.

**Role**

Once Sales converts a prospect into a customer, you own the account for its lifetime: you build the relationship, keep them buying, and grow what they spend. Retention, expansion, and goodwill are your job, and your book of business is your number.

**Responsibilities**

* Take the handoff from Sales at go-live, run onboarding, and get each customer to early results fast.
* Monitor account health (purchase frequency, lead quality feedback, support history, payment activity) and reach out before customers go quiet.
* Build goodwill by responding fast, telling customers the truth, following through, and advocating for them internally.
* Grow accounts through new markets and increased budget once the customer's core concerns are resolved.
* When an account is at risk, overcome their objections and redirect them back to their original goal.
* Log every customer conversation, risk, and outcome in the CRM.

**Requirements**

* 3–5+ years owning a book of B2B accounts, with a measurable record of keeping customers and growing their spend. You should be able to tell us your retention rate and how much expansion revenue you closed.
* Experience owning a book of business and building genuine relationships with your book.
* Strong negotiation, objection handling, and de-escalation skills.
* Comfortable in a CRM and managing a pipeline.
* Nice to have: lead-gen or other repeat-purchase experience; real estate investor, roofer, or very small-business customers; experience as a real estate investor/agent or roofer.

**Results**

* Retention: When a customer requests to cancel, you overcome their objections to keep them spending.
* Expansion: You encourage the customers who are spending to spend more (increase budget, add more markets)
* Goodwill: You build and maintain relationships with every customer in your book of business. Gather testimonials and get them to refer others to Property Leads.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Base Salary: $50,000 per year
* On target annual earnings of $86,000
* Great company culture – a highly successful, small business, where people invest in helping each other grow
* Retirement plan with company match (401K)
* Medical, vision, and dental coverage

**The Opportunity**

We are a national leader in pavement maintenance and infrastructure services with aggressive growth targets, active M&A activity, and a platform built to win large enterprise relationships across the country. The National Account Manager excels at managing complex sales cycles, multi-site program management, and relentless new business development.

This is both a relationship-management role and a hunter-builder position. You will land and expand national accounts across high-value verticals and act as the commercial face of our platform for the country's largest facility operators. **This is a role to build, not simply to maintain** - National Accounts is where this company's growth will be won.

**What You Will Own**

**New National Account Growth**

* Own a named target list of enterprise prospects across retail, logistics, industrial, healthcare, hospitality, and commercial real estate - driving them through the pipeline with urgency and consistency
* Build and execute outbound prospecting strategies including direct outreach, industry networking, broker and GPO channel relationships, and referral development
* Lead full-cycle complex sales from first contact through signed MSA - including discovery, site assessment, multi-location scoping, pricing, and contract close
* Hit and exceed quarterly new-logo targets; document all activity, pipeline, and stage movement in CRM with precision

**National Account Expansion**

* Once accounts are landed, develop expansion strategies to grow wallet share across additional locations, service lines, and capital programs
* Match effort to opportunity - invest in deep, multi-year programs for the highest-value accounts, and manage the rest of the portfolio with proportionate rigor rather than treating every account the same
* Build multi-year pavement management programs - condition assessments, CapEx planning, preventative maintenance schedules, and ADA compliance roadmaps - that lock in long-term partnerships
* Conduct quarterly and annual business reviews with executive-level stakeholders, presenting performance data, program outcomes, and growth recommendations
* Identify and pursue upsell and cross-sell opportunities within active accounts

**Program Processing & Operational Scalability**

* Inform the design of national account processes - intake, onboarding, SLA frameworks, hand-off protocols - bringing the field insight that makes them work, and following them consistently once set
* Partner with regional operations leaders to ensure national program standards are met consistently across every market
* Drive continuous improvement in how national accounts are processed, tracked, reported, and renewed - building repeatable systems that scale with our growth
* Manage contract compliance, program KPIs, and customer reporting with a high degree of operational rigor

**Commercial Leadership**

* Lead all pricing, contract negotiations, and MSA execution for national accounts - balancing competitive positioning with margin discipline
* Respond to RFPs and national bid opportunities with compelling, differentiated proposals
* Maintain a deep understanding of competitive dynamics, procurement trends, and customer needs to sharpen our national go-to-market approach
* Feed market intelligence and customer feedback directly into leadership to inform pricing, product, and M&A strategy

**Who You Are**

You have a proven track record closing and growing national, multi-site enterprise accounts - ideally in pavement, facilities maintenance, commercial construction, outsourced services, or adjacent industries. You are as comfortable building pipeline from scratch as you are running a QBR with a VP of Real Estate. You bring urgency and accountability to everything you do, and you are energized by the chance to build something meaningful at a company with real momentum.

**Required**

* 5+ years of B2B enterprise or national account sales experience with documented revenue results
* Experience managing multi-million-dollar customer relationships across multiple locations or geographies
* Track record of new-logo acquisition and account expansion - not just account maintenance
* Experience selling construction, facilities, infrastructure, maintenance, or outsourced service solutions to enterprise buyers
* Skilled at navigating complex sales cycles involving procurement, facilities leadership, operations, finance, and the C-suite
* CRM fluency (Salesforce or equivalent) and strong pipeline-management discipline

**Preferred**

* Experience within the pavement, asphalt, concrete, or specialty contractor industries

* Background working inside a high-growth, acquisition-oriented, or multi-market platform organization

Remote

We’re hiring a Behavioral Health Case Manager to help patients access, remain engaged in, and transition between the services they need. This role will support patients with complex behavioral health needs, including those moving between levels of care, while maintaining the flexibility to support outpatient psychiatry and therapy.

You will work closely with patients, clinicians, internal program teams, insurers, and external partners to remove barriers, coordinate services, and close the loop on referrals and transitions. You will not provide psychotherapy, diagnose patients, or make independent clinical or level-of-care decisions. You will be expected to recognize changes in risk or acuity and escalate promptly to the appropriate clinician.

  

**About Talkiatry:**
--------------------

Talkiatry is transforming mental health care by making high-quality psychiatry more accessible, human, and sustainable for both patients and clinicians. Co-founded by a patient and a triple-board-certified psychiatrist, we were built to solve one of healthcare’s most urgent challenges: millions of people struggle to access mental health care, while clinicians face growing administrative burden and burnout. Through our technology-powered, in-network platform, we’re changing that, creating a better experience for patients and empowering clinicians to focus on delivering exceptional care.

  

Today, Talkiatry is the largest dedicated psychiatry practice in the U.S., with 750+ psychiatrists, 250+ therapists, and more than two million patient visits delivered nationwide. At our scale, every innovation has real impact. Every workflow we improve, every technology solution we build, and every patient experience we redesign helps thousands of clinicians provide better care to hundreds of thousands of patients. We’re not just growing quickly — we’re redefining how behavioral healthcare is delivered in America.

  

Joining Talkiatry means joining a mission-driven team that is solving complex problems at scale, driving meaningful change in healthcare, and building the future of mental health care with compassion, innovation, and purpose.

  

**You Will:**
-------------

* Works with patients across new and existing behavioral health programs, adjusting priorities based on patient need, acuity, and program demand.
* Support patients through enrollment, ongoing engagement, discharge, step-down, and return to outpatient care, with clear ownership of each transition until the next service is confirmed.
* Conduct timely outreach, identify barriers to care, and help patients navigate benefits, transportation, community resources, specialty services, and other supports.
* Coordinate closely with psychiatrists, psychiatric mental health nurse practitioners, therapists, primary care providers, and external treatment partners.
* Identify changes in patient risk, engagement, or functioning and escalate clinical concerns according to established protocols.
* Participate in crisis coordination by facilitating referrals to emergency, inpatient, residential, or other higher-acuity services under clinical direction.
* Manage inbound and outbound referrals, including communication with insurers and partner organizations, transfer of necessary records, and confirmation that handoffs are completed.
* Document case management activity and patient communication accurately and on time in the electronic health record to support continuity, quality reporting, and compliant billing.
* Maintain current knowledge of internal programs and external resources and contribute to improving the team's service repository and referral pathways.
* Track workload, referral status, barriers, outcomes, and care transitions, and use that information to identify operational gaps.
* Help build and refine case management workflows as Talkiatry expands its services for patients with more complex care needs.

**You Have:**
-------------

* A bachelor's degree in social work, psychology, counseling, public health, human services, or a related field.
* At least three years of behavioral health case management, care coordination, discharge planning, or healthcare navigation experience.
* Direct experience supporting higher-acuity behavioral health populations, including crisis care, discharge planning, structured treatment settings, or transitions between levels of care.
* The ability to work independently, manage multiple active cases, prioritize time-sensitive needs, and follow work through to completion.
* Strong judgment about when a situation requires escalation to a clinical review or immediate emergency workflows.
* Experience working with multidisciplinary clinical teams and external healthcare or community partners.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and experience documenting work in an electronic health record or care management platform and experience using AI tools to increase efficiency.
* Comfort working in a virtual environment and adapting as programs, workflows, and responsibilities evolve.

Licensure is not required. An LMSW, LSW, LPC, LMHC, CADC, CASAC, or other relevant credential may be considered, but this position does not provide psychotherapy or perform clinical services.

**How You Work:**
-----------------

* Patient centered. You listen carefully, communicate clearly, and help patients navigate difficult systems without losing ownership of the next step
* Strong follow through. You track details, close loops, and deliver on commitments
* Sound judgment. You understand the boundary between coordination and clinical decision-making and escalate concerns quickly
* Comfort with change. You can work effectively while new programs and workflows are still being bui

Finance & Operations Manager

$70,000 to $90,000 + performance bonus + equity + healthcare stipend

**About E4C5**

E4C5 is a founder-led boutique agency that applies product management discipline to digital marketing. We partner with B2B SaaS companies, cybersecurity firms, and high-growth technology businesses to drive measurable growth through AI search, SEO, CRO, and paid media.

Our roster includes venture-backed security startups and fast-growing SaaS companies that rely on us as embedded strategic partners. Our MRR has doubled over the last 6 months and our client book has grown 300% over the course of '26. We're bringing on a foundational leader to own the back of the house as we scale.

**The Role**

You'll be our first dedicated leader for the back of house: finance, HR and people operations, compliance, contracts, and the systems that hold the company together. You'll report directly to the founder and CEO. There's no finance or HR expert above you, so you'll own the function, design how it works, and tell us what we should be doing.

We don't expect anyone to be an expert in all of it. You might bring deep accounting experience and less HR, or strong HR, contracts, and compliance experience and less core accounting. What matters is that you're excellent at one or more of these areas, curious about the adjacent ones, and excited to close the gaps as we grow.

This role is built to grow. As E4C5 scales, you'll have a clear path to leading finance and operations for the company.

**What You'll Do**

First 90 days: get the foundation right

Some of this work is unglamorous, and it's the work that keeps a growing company safe.

* Keep us compliant across states, including payroll tax and unemployment registrations, workers' comp, business insurance, licensing, and entity filings.
* Own invoicing, accounts receivable, and collections so cash comes in on time.
* Manage accounts payable, contractor payments, and vendor relationships.
* Run payroll and benefits administration, plus onboarding and offboarding from offer letter to system access.
* Run the monthly close, delivering accurate P&L, cash flow, and MRR reporting.
* Reconcile billable hours and client spend against contracts and invoices so nothing is over- or under-billed.

As you grow: help shape the business

* Build financial models, projections, and headwind and tailwind forecasts for the CEO.
* Partner with the CEO and Head of Delivery on pricing: what we should charge, where margins are thin, and when scope needs to change.
* Lead annual budgeting and help support our 2027 planning.
* Track utilization, effective billable rates, and margins by client and service line.
* Flag financial risks early, from client concentration to contractor costs and margin erosion.
* Own contract administration and renewal tracking, and bring in outside counsel when legal judgment is needed.

**What You'll Get to Build**

You'll design the architecture of our back office, not inherit someone else's. That includes our payroll platform, whether we use a PEO, our benefits program, our finance and HR tool stack, how we run the monthly close, and how we budget each year.

You'll bring recommendations, align with the CEO on the big decisions, and then own the implementation. We expect you to use AI and automation to make recurring work faster and more consistent, with the judgment to check the output when accuracy matters.

**What We're Looking For**

Must-haves

* Deep, hands-on strength in at least one of these: finance and accounting, HR and people operations, or contracts and compliance, ideally in a small business, agency, consultancy, or other services business.
* Working knowledge of QuickBooks and a payroll platform like Gusto, or the ability to get there quickly.
* Strong judgment about when to handle something yourself and when to bring in outside experts.
* The ability to translate accounting, legal, and compliance details into plain-language recommendations for the CEO.
* Highly organized and discreet with sensitive information.

Strong pluses

* Five or more years of relevant experience.
* Agency or retainer-based billing and time tracking.
* Multi-state employment compliance for a remote team.
* Experience using AI and automation to cut manual work out of finance, HR, or operations.

**Who you are**

You're ambitious, low ego, and act like an owner. You bring problems forward early, along with a recommendation for how to solve them. You enjoy a wide range of work, you like learning the parts of the job that are new to you, and you're energized by a lot of autonomy.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within 90 days: We're compliant in every state where we have employees. Invoicing and collections run on a predictable schedule, the monthly close is clean and on time, and the CEO has a clear view of cash, revenue, and profitability without having to ask.

Longer term: You're helping shape how the business grows, not just tracking it. You're advising on pricing, hiring, margins, and investment decisions, you've built a back office that scales, and you're leading finance and operations as the company grows.

**Why This Role**

* Real ownership from day one. You'll lead a function, not take orders, and you'll have a major say in how the company runs.
* Direct access to the founder. You report only to the CEO, with no layers in between and no one micromanaging your area.
* Controls you design. We want lightweight, sensible processes, and you'll be the one to build them.
* Breadth. You'll see finance, people, legal, revenue operations, and planning up close at a fast-growing company.
* A path to leadership. As we scale, this role grows into leading finance and operations.
* Eligibility for our phantom equity plan, which is currently being formalized.
* Fully remote work with flexible hours.

new_jobs.title: Intensive Case Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Intensive Home Service Provider provides an intensive form of case management that facilitates care coordination for children and youth in foster care or Juvenile Justice System, or at risk of out-of-home placement. The IHSP provides skill building sessions directly to clients as well as parent coaching. IHSP’s facilitate Child and Family Team (CFT) meetings and supports the ICC in necessary tasks related to stabilizing a client’s symptoms and improving their functioning.

**What we can offer you:**

* Signing Bonus
* Hybrid Remote Model with company laptop
* Realistic caseload
* 12 Paid Holidays, and a Floating Holiday!
* Paid Vacation and Sick time
* Comprehensive benefit plan with four Health Plan Options (we pay 95% of premiums!)
* 403(b) Retirement Plan with match
* Additional pay for bilingual staff
* Eligibility for the State Loan Forgiveness Program
* Free access to Headspace mindfulness application

**Duties and responsibilities**

* Coordinate care for clients with a multidisciplinary clinical team and outside agencies including developing effective working relationships with agencies and organizations to advocate for clients.
* Work collaboratively with the Intensive Care Coordinator assigned to the case to assist in monitoring progress for effectiveness of interventions and make decisions regarding the need to adjust treatment or find additional resources and supports.
* Provide collaborative, culturally sensitive, strengths based, client centered individual/group/family rehabilitation services to youth and their families.
* Complete all documentation per Medi-Cal, Santa Clara County and AACI standards within expected deadlines.
* Schedule, facilitate and participate in Child and Family Team (CFT) meetings.
* Facilitate referral linkages to community resources and perform case management services.
* Participate in clinical supervision, consultations, trainings, and team meetings.
* Assist clients with the development of social and community support systems.
* Complete other related duties and projects as assigned.

**Qualifications**

Education & Experience:

* Bachelor's degree in social work or a related field; or equivalent education, training, and experience.
* One year or more of case management and rehabilitation services experience working with parents and youth.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

* Knowledge of community and county resources to facilitate referrals and coordination with appropriate agencies.
* Knowledge of trauma informed care.
* Knowledge of the child welfare system and juvenile probation system preferred.
* Knowledge of mandated reporter laws in California.
* Knowledge of crisis de-escalation interventions.
* Proficient writing skills.
* Proficiency in usage of basic technological tools including laptops/computers, email, phones, and internet required.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite required.
* Ability to maintain a valid California driver license, current personal auto insurance, and an MVR sufficient to maintain insurability under agency auto liability.
* Verbal and written fluency in English required; Bilingual skills in a second language (particularly Spanish, Mandarin, Vietnamese) desired but not required.

***Competencies:***

* Ability to communicate well with people of diverse cultural professional and experiential backgrounds.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective work relationships as part of a multi-disciplinary team.

**Working conditions**

This job requires you to be in the community, in client’s homes, and other community partner sites. Work is often conducted in an office environment. Basic safety precautions and use of protective clothing or gear may be required. Working with clients who are seriously mentally ill, or high risk may increase exposure to secondary trauma. Driving is essential to the function of this job. The job requires travel up to 25% of the time. Occasional evening and weekend work is required.

**Physical requirements**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to regularly sit for extended periods of time and regularly operate a computer and use manual dexterity for tasks such as keyboarding. The mental demands of the job include regular comprehension, reasoning, decision making, interpreting and analyzing data, organizing, reading, writing, and resilience.

**Job Type:** Full-Time, Exempt

**About Rocket Youth**

Rocket Youth owns and operates a growing portfolio of youth sports, enrichment, and after-school businesses across the United States. Our platform is intentionally multi-brand and multi-location, with each business maintaining its unique identity and local market focus.

We are highly acquisitive, completing approximately 10–15 acquisitions per year. Most of our companies are founder-led, with experienced local operators managing day-to-day operations.

Rocket Youth provides operational leadership and support services to improve performance and scale. These services span marketing, CRM, analytics, M&A/de-novo expansion, accounting, finance, HR, capital, and more.

new_jobs.title: Executive Operations and Office Manager
new_jobs.description:
Develop Health is on a mission to use AI to radically accelerate access to life-saving medications. By automating complex, manual healthcare processes—like benefit verification and prior authorization— **we've been growing rapidly and over the past couple of years have helped over 3.6 million patients!**

We’re partnering with some of the largest pharmacy benefit managers and payers in the nation, revolutionizing how healthcare interactions occur by eliminating human delays and inefficiencies. Our small, elite team of founders and engineers have previously launched and exited successful healthcare startups including Rupa Health and Canvas Medical. We are now scaling rapidly following a major funding round.

**The Role**
------------

Our executives spend their days building the product and closing deals with the biggest names in healthcare and life sciences. You'll keep everything around them running smoothly, while also ensuring our offices are productive, collaborative places to work that celebrate our team.

65% of your time goes to supporting our CEO, CTO and Chief Commercial Officer: their calendars, travel, meetings and relationships, plus the culture work that keeps our team connected. The other 35% goes to employee engagement and running our core office in San Francisco and satellite office in Menlo Park. You'll report to our Senior Manager, Strategy & Finance.

You’ll be the first full-time partner to our leaders, able to unlock a new level of focus and support. You’ll help us optimize our Menlo office, including transitioning it to a smaller satellite space in mid-2027, while helping us open and optimize our new, San Francisco office in January 2027.

The role is a match for someone who solves problems creatively, keeps finding better ways to do things, and has a gift for hospitality. As the company scales, special projects and increased responsibilities are likely. This is a great entry point into the company, and will give you visibility into the full business.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**Support our C-Suite**

* Own their calendars. Expect lots of external meetings, tricky scheduling and plans that change daily.
* Work with our Sr. Manager of Strategy and Finance to build agendas for team and leadership meetings, help run them, and capture notes and action items.
* Plan on-site and off-site meetings, dinners and team events.
* Book complex travel for our executives, arrange travel and accommodation for visitors coming to Develop Health, and prepare expense reports.
* Be the face and voice of Develop Health as you reach out on behalf of our team, and help us build great relationships with senior leaders at our partners and customers.

**Build our culture**

* Company-Wide: Nurture our fast-paced, collaborative, and active culture with team gatherings, lunches, and celebrations.
* For Individuals: Partner with our People and Talent team to bring the magic to onboarding, work anniversaries, birthdays, and special milestones.

**Run our offices**

* Set up both offices to be productive, collaborative workspaces that folks are excited to come into each week: choose and manage vendors, organize the spaces, and create our office manual, routines and protocols.
* Keep the SF office clean, organized and ready for the team. That means non-janitorial tidying of common areas, meeting rooms, the kitchen and storage.
* Keep us stocked with everything from stationery to snacks, drinks and coffee.
* Coordinate team lunches, and set up for special events and All Hands.
* Troubleshoot Zoom and Google Meet room devices, room booking tablets, and AirPlay or cable connections for all hands meetings.
* Handle mail, packages and shipping for the team.
* Be the main contact for office vendors, including catering, building management and maintenance.

**About you**
-------------

* You’re excited to work onsite in San Francisco, Tuesday through Thursday each week, with a day in Menlo Park every other week to ensure that office is flowing. Time in Menlo may decrease as we transition this to a satellite office.
* You have 3+ years supporting a senior executive at a fast-paced company
* You've worked in office management, workplace experience or operations.
* You can juggle many requests that each feel urgent to the person asking. You prioritize, keep people updated, and get it all done without losing your cool.
* You move fast and make decisions on the spot without missing details. When things are ambiguous or changing, you stay calm and keep your sense of humor.
* You set a high bar. Nothing gets dropped, and our executives trust your work completely.
* You're AI-native. You use Claude to work faster, and you bring the judgment, taste and human touch that make every message feel thoughtful and polished.
* You're a straight shooter. If you disagree, you say so up front. If the answer is still no, you commit and make it happen.
* You spot needs before anyone asks and find solutions on your own.
* You're warm and welcoming, communicate clearly, and work well with all kinds of personalities.
* You're strong in Gmail, Google Calendar, Sheets, Slides, Excel and PowerPoint, and you can set up basic office A/V with confidence.
* You're reliable and punctual. You're online and responsive during business hours, closing loops to keep the team’s work flowing.

**Bonus points**
----------------

* You already have a system for supporting a busy executive team and running an office.
* You have experience in business operations, recruiting or HR and can help support the other biz ops staff

Compensation Range: $75K - $90K

Location: **South San Francisco**

Type: **Full-time / On-Site**

Ohalo is hiring a Senior Program Manager (PM) to lead strategic programs across the organization. You will run cross-functional programs that span Biotech R&D, engineering, and operations. You will take complex initiatives from concept to delivery.

This is a full-accountability leadership role. You will act as general manager for a set of high-impact programs. You will own outcomes, set strategy, and direct work across technical and business teams.

This role requires strong program management fundamentals and a track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives. You should be a strong leader and systems thinker who is motivated to build AI apps and agents that keep work running continuously.

The ideal person thrives in a high-ownership, fast-moving environment and is excited by leading complex, high-stakes initiatives from ambiguity to execution. AI is changing how biological discovery and development get done. We want someone who will lead that change, not wait for it.

**Responsibilities:**

**Program General Management & Accountability**

* Own program success for one or more strategic, cross-functional programs.
* Design and implement scalable processes and methods for planning, execution, and tracking.
* Drive alignment with stakeholders and executive leadership. own decisions, escalations, and accountability.
* Own budgeting, forecasting, and analytics of managed programs.

**Cross-Functional Execution & Communication**

* Build and maintain integrated program plans that connect workstreams across teams. Make dependencies and critical paths explicit, and manage them.
* Define how each program fits together: workstreams, interfaces, handoffs, and validation. Keep teams executing to one integrated schedule.
* Make the call on trade-offs and escalations; drive alignment across scientists, operators, and executive leadership without waiting for consensus.
* Spot bottlenecks early and unblock teams through clear priorities and fast follow-through.
* Translate technical complexity into clear artifacts for audiences ranging from scientists to Ohalo's board.
* Use AI as a force multiplier that runs program work, continuously (tracking, reporting, follow-ups), not one-off analyses or reports. Hold a high bar for accuracy and traceability.
* Hold the team to the same standard and help each member build AI into how they work.

  

**Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience leading cross-functional programs in R&D, Engineering, technology, operations, or a related field.
* Strong engineering fundamentals, with experience taking technical work from design through deployment.
* Hands-on with AI and eager to go further: you use AI tools in your daily work and want to build apps and agents that run work continuously, not just one-off analyses or reports.
* Strong systems thinker. Comfortable working across disciplines and turning ambiguity into executable plans.
* Track record of leading cross-functional teams and delivering on timelines and commitments.
* Proven ability to influence without authority and build alignment between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* High-ownership leader who is energized by mission-driven work and follows through.
* First-principles thinker who questions "how it's always been done" and isn't afraid to redesign a process.
* A Bachelor's degree is required, ideally in a technical discipline. An advanced degree is preferred
* Experience in a scientific, technical, or engineering environment is required.
  

*The anticipated base pay range for this role is $180,000 - $220,000 per year for our South San Francisco location. The pay offered to a selected candidate will be determined based on factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the qualifications of the selected candidate, budget availability, internal equity, geographic location and external market pay for comparable jobs.*

**About Ohalo:**

Ohalo™ aims to accelerate evolution to unlock nature's potential. Founded in 2019, Ohalo develops novel breeding systems and improved plant varieties that help farmers grow more food with fewer natural resources, increasing the yield, resiliency, and genetic diversity of crops to sustainably feed our population. Ohalo's breakthrough technology, Boosted Breeding™, will usher in a new era of improved productivity to radically transform global agriculture. For more information, visit www.ohalo.com.

*Notes: If you previously applied for a job at Ohalo Genetics, we encourage you to restate your interest in the position by submitting your application.*

*No visa sponsorship is available for this position at this time.*

*Ohalo is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Ohalo is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.*

new_jobs.title: Model Evaluation Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Dyna Robotics** builds general-purpose robots powered by a proprietary embodied AI foundation model with top-in-industry generalization and real-world performance. Already deployed with customers across multiple industries, our robots do commercial-grade work in the physical world. Our team comes from Google DeepMind, Meta, and Cruise, and we're backed by CRV, First Round, and other leading investors.

**The Role**
============

Dyna Robotics is building general-purpose robots that perform useful work in real-world environments. We’re looking for a Model Evaluation Lead to lead the team responsible for understanding how our robot policies perform and whether new model versions deliver meaningful improvements.

You’ll manage and develop the evaluation team, own evaluation planning and execution, and work closely with researchers to define what we test, how we measure it, and what we learn. This is a hands-on leadership role combining people management, experimental rigor, and technical judgment. Your work will help researchers understand model behavior, prioritize improvements, and assess readiness for deployment.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* **Manage work flows for the evaluation team.** Manage the team’s priorities. Establish clear ownership, provide regular coaching and feedback, and build onboarding and training practices that help team members execute evaluations and investigate issues independently.
* **Work closely with researchers.** Translate research questions into evaluation plans with clear hypotheses, success criteria, and deliverables. Partner with researchers to compare model checkpoints, assess new capabilities, and balance recurring evaluations with urgent experiments and available robot capacity.
* **Design meaningful evaluations.** Develop task definitions, scoring rubrics, and test scenarios that reflect real operating conditions. Measure task success, output quality, cycle time, human interventions, and recovery behavior. Choose appropriate trial counts and account for variability when interpreting results.
* **Make results repeatable and trustworthy.** Standardize setup, resets, scoring, and intervention rules. Ensure results are traceable to model versions, robot configurations, test conditions, logs, and videos. Coordinate with hardware and operations partners to resolve issues that affect evaluation quality.
* **Turn failures into actionable findings.** Review robot behavior, logs, and video with the team and researchers. Distinguish model failures from hardware, software, setup, or execution issues. Identify recurring failure patterns and recommend focused investigations, additional data collection, or annotation improvements.
* **Own regression coverage and reporting.** Maintain consistent benchmarks and held-out test scenarios across tasks and conditions. Identify regressions, track progress across model versions, and communicate what improved, what remains unreliable, and where evidence is still limited. Provide clear recommendations that inform deployment decisions.
* **Improve evaluation tools and workflows.** Use data analysis and lightweight scripting to improve reporting and reduce manual work. Partner with engineering on evaluation tooling, automation, and dashboards. Shorten the time from a new checkpoint to useful findings while preserving the quality of the evidence.

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

* Experience in robotics, machine learning, applied research, or model evaluation, with direct ownership of evaluation design and analysis.
* Demonstrated experience managing and developing a technical team, including setting priorities, giving feedback, and building effective working practices.
* Strong experimental judgment: you can define success, control relevant variables, identify gaps in test coverage, and assess whether an apparent improvement is meaningful.
* Technical fluency to work directly with researchers on model checkpoints, generalization, data quality, and experimental tradeoffs.
* Comfort using Python or similar tools to analyze results, inspect logs, and improve evaluation workflows.
* Clear communication and strong ownership. You can turn an ambiguous request into an executable plan, surface problems early, and explain findings to both research and operations teams.

**Bonus Points For**
====================

* Evaluating robot manipulation policies, embodied AI, autonomous systems, or other machine learning systems operating in the physical world.
* Building regression suites, benchmark datasets, failure taxonomies, or evaluation tools, and connecting findings to model development or deployment readiness.

*At* ***Dyna Robotics****, we build technology for the real world, which requires a team as diverse as the environments our robots inhabit. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to technical rigor and mutual respect.*

***Don’t let a checklist stop you.*** *Data shows that underrepresented groups often only apply if they meet 100% of the criteria. We value problem-solving and grit over keyword matching. If you’re passionate about robotics, no matter your discipline, we want to hear from you, even if you don't check every box.*

Compensation Range: $140K - $160K

You'll use guided control interfaces to move robots through defined task sequences.
