new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**

As a Quality Assurance Technician, you will play a vital role in upholding our commitment to precision by verifying that machined components meet rigorous engineering specifications. Your expertise in metrology and documentation will ensure that every part leaving our facility adheres to the highest quality standards, directly impacting our operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

**Responsibilities**

* Execute first-piece, in-process, and final inspections to validate CNC machining accuracy.
* Utilize CMM equipment to verify complex geometries and tight tolerances.
* Prepare comprehensive First Article Inspection (FAI) reports to satisfy customer and QMS requirements.
* Maintain precise quality records and manage data entry within our digital tracking systems.
* Ensure all measurement instrumentation remains calibrated and reliable according to industry standards.
* Facilitate the disposition of non-conforming materials to maintain workflow integrity.
* Participate in internal and external audits to support our continuous improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications**

#### **Required Skills**

* 6+ years of experience in a precision machining inspection environment.
* Proficiency with manual metrology tools including micrometers, calipers, and height gages.
* Advanced ability to interpret complex blueprints and apply GD&T principles.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple inspection priorities.
* Competence in computer-based documentation and quality data management.

#### **Preferred Skills**

* Demonstrated experience in CMM programming, specifically using PC-DMIS.
* Technical proficiency with optical comparators and air gaging systems.
* Strong grasp of trigonometry for complex measurement calculations.
* Prior experience managing or assisting with gage calibration programs.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (Digital Health & Pharmacy)
new_jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
new_jobs.description:
Develop Health is on a mission to use AI to radically accelerate access to life-saving medications. By automating complex, manual healthcare processes—like benefit verification and prior authorization— **we've been growing rapidly and over the past couple of years have helped over 3.6 million patients!**

We’re partnering with some of the largest pharmacy benefit managers and payers in the nation, revolutionizing how healthcare interactions occur by eliminating human delays and inefficiencies. Our small, elite team of founders and engineers have previously launched and exited successful healthcare startups including Rupa Health and Canvas Medical. We are now scaling rapidly following a major funding round.

**About The Role**
------------------

We're hiring a **Customer Success Manager** to own a book of digital health and pharmacy accounts after they sign.

This role doesn't carry a quota. You're measured on retention, renewals, and volume growth from your accounts, and you'll work closely with product and engineering.

Day to day, you'll learn each customer's goals and follow through on what you commit to. You'll watch usage and support data to catch problems early, and bring forward places where customers could send us more volume.

Candidates from outside healthcare are welcome. You'll need to learn a complex domain quickly.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Own a book of accounts**

* Be the main post-sale contact for a set of digital health and pharmacy customers.
* Agree on success criteria with each account and track them.
* Run regular check-ins and business reviews using our templates, and improve them as you go.

**Protect and grow revenue**

* Watch account health and act on early signs of trouble.
* Support renewals and flag expansion opportunities to the team.

**Be the customer's voice inside Develop Health**

* Bring feedback and recurring issues to product and engineering, with examples.
* Resolve customer issues end to end, and escalate the complex ones with the right context.

**What You'll Bring On Day 1**
------------------------------

* **3+ years in a post-sale, account-owning role** (Customer Success, Account Management) with named accounts.
* **Outcomes you can point to**. Renewals, saves, or growth on accounts you owned.
* **B2B experience.** Your customers were companies.
* **Follow-through.** You track what you owe people and close the loop without being chased.
* **Comfort with data.** You can read a dashboard and explain what changed.

**What You'll Need To Learn Quickly**
-------------------------------------

* **Our domain:** prior authorization, benefit verification, PBMs and payers, and why they matter to our customers.
* **Our customers' businesses:** how a telehealth company or a pharmacy works day to day.
* **Our product:** what it does, and how to explain it plainly.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Account management at a health-tech company, a pharmacy, or a pharma services company.
* Pharmacy tech (CPhT) or pharmacy operations experience in a customer-facing role.
* Supported high-volume or integration-heavy customers (APIs, EHRs).
* Experience at an early-stage startup.
* Experience with CS tools (Pylon, Gainsight, Vitally).

**This Might Not Be The Right Fit If**
--------------------------------------

* **You want a quota.** New logos belong to our sales team.
* **You prefer working a support queue.** You'll solve customer issues end to end, and you'll also own account health and support renewals.
* **You want to manage people right away.** This is an individual contributor role.
* **You need a lot of structure.** Helping build it is part of the job.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base salary plus meaningful early-stage equity.
* Health, dental, and vision coverage, 401k matching, plus flexible PTO.
* A clear path to a strategic book of accounts as we grow.
* Work that directly speeds up access to medication for hundreds of thousands of patients.

Compensation Range: $140K - $160K

new_jobs.title: Utilities Infrastructure Project Manager (Wastewater)
new_jobs.description:
The Utilities Infrastructure Project Manager (Wastewater) delivers Havenpark’s wastewater infrastructure projects, including wastewater treatment plants, collection systems, tanks, and drainage, on budget and by the budgeted completion dates. The role owns each assigned project from scope definition through closeout, managing the engineers and contractors to completion. The wastewater portfolio currently includes about 53 open projects totaling $9.5 million.

This role is accountable for completion. Community managers and Regional Vice Presidents (RVP) stay informed and partner on access and communication, but they are not responsible for finishing the work. The Sr. Utilities Program Manager sets priorities and selects projects and also owns compliance, operators, and utility emergency response, so this role can stay focused on projects.

On critical projects and others that need an engineer for design and construction, the position manages the engineers and holds them to scope, schedule, and cost. It reinforces Havenpark’s values and purpose-driven culture of creating caring communities.

### **Project Planning & Delivery**

* Own a portfolio of wastewater projects from scope definition through closeout, finishing each on budget and on schedule, with no projects past due.
* Define scope fully before bidding, including what is and is not included, so contractors price and plan the real work and change requests are rare.
* Build the plan up front: lead times, agency review times, access and seasonal constraints, and potential start delays. Start early enough to finish on time.
* Maintain project plans, milestones, and budgeted completion dates in project management software; flag risks early and recover projects that go past due.
* Visit project sites as needed, and verify that work is actually complete and ready before marking a project complete.
* Close out projects with final documentation, as-builts, warranties, and lessons learned.

### **Contractor & Engineer Management**

* Manage engineers and contractors to completion on every assigned project, holding them accountable for quality, safety, schedule, and cost.
* Walk contractors through the scope and schedule before they start and confirm their understanding in writing; manage bids, contracts, and change orders; and compare change requests against the survey, scope, and drawings before approving.
* Engage engineers for design and construction on critical projects and other projects that require engineering; define their scopes of work, review designs and cost estimates, and review invoices and progress reports.
* Select and develop a reliable bench of contractors in the assigned region and replace those who do not perform, with documented reasons.

### **Permitting & Regulatory Coordination**

* Coordinate wastewater project permits, plan reviews, and approvals with state agencies and local authorities, in partnership with the Sr. Utilities Program Manager.
* Build agency review time into every plan, respond quickly to agency comments, and confirm approvals and conditions are cleared before work starts.
* Ensure projects are built and documented to meet regulatory requirements, and hand off completed systems and documentation to the Sr. Utilities Program Manager for ongoing compliance.

### **Budget, Cost Control & Reporting**

* Develop project budgets and cost forecasts; track actual costs against the budget and report variances early.
* Report project status, past-due projects, risks, and needed decisions to the VP of Capital Projects and the Sr. Utilities Program Manager on an agreed cadence.
* Support annual utility budget planning with project scopes and cost estimates.

### **Collaboration & Business Partnership**

* Keep community managers and RVPs informed about schedules, access, and anything that affects their communities, serving as a single point of contact so they don't have to field calls from multiple parties.
* Partner with the Sr. Utilities Program Manager on project priorities, sequencing, and capital needs identified through system health and compliance findings.
* Stay on the shared outage communication thread and assist as needed; the Sr. Utilities Program Manager leads utility emergency response.
* Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and care consistent with Havenpark’s purpose of creating caring communities.

### **Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in engineering, environmental science, or a related field preferred.
* **Experience:** 3-5 years managing utility infrastructure projects, specifically wastewater.
* **Certification:** Project Management Professional (PMP) preferred, not required.
* **Skills & Knowledge:**
* Wastewater treatment, collection, tank, and drainage project delivery, from design through construction and closeout
* Wastewater regulations, agency plan review, and permitting
* Construction contracts, bidding, change orders, and vendor management
* Project budgeting, forecasting, and cost tracking
* Project management software and scheduling tools
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Self-motivated, organized problem solver able to manage multiple projects and priorities independently
* High learning agility; works well with all levels of the organization and is a strong team player
* **Physical Demands & Additional Requirements**

  Primarily an office-based position with typical physical demands related to extended computer and phone use, including long periods of sitting, and periods of walking and standing at project sites in outdoor conditions. Travel is expected about once per quarter to visit large projects, with occasional additional travel for meetings.

  Able to pass a criminal background check.

**Description**

The Project Manager independently manages technology projects or serves as a Project Manager within a broader program with guidance available from more experienced coworkers. Projects are typically low to medium in complexity and risk and may involve mainstream, legacy, or select emerging technologies, a defined solution area, and third-party providers. The Project Manager owns day-to-day project delivery from initiation through closure and works with sales, consultants, clients, subcontractors, and cross-functional delivery teams. The role is accountable for managing project scope, schedule, budget, contractual deliverables, risks, issues, quality, and stakeholder expectations within established parameters. The Project Manager acts as a project advocate by driving results, supporting timely decisions, and building effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

**What You Will Do**

* Project Management: Independently manages low- to medium-complexity projects using CDW-G’s established delivery methodology and standard project management templates. Adapts project artifacts as needed within established practices to meet the needs of the engagement.
* Ensures the client’s documented business, technical, contractual, and operational requirements are understood and addressed throughout project delivery.
* Manages Stakeholders: Identifies project stakeholders, confirms success criteria and expectations, and involves the appropriate stakeholders in project decisions. Builds effective relationships and remains focused on meeting stakeholder expectations.
* Accountable for project financial performance within the approved budget. Monitors, interprets, and communicates project budget, actuals, forecast, and estimate-at-completion information. Escalates significant variances and supports corrective actions.
* Ensures project time, expenses, invoices, and financial records are accurately tracked, reviewed, and approved in a timely manner.
* Validates initial project scope, assumptions, estimates, deliverables, and acceptance criteria. Manages the change-control process, assesses impacts to scope, schedule, cost, resources, and risk, and determines whether a Change Order or new Statement of Work may be required.
* Ensures all items defined in the CDW Statement of Work are delivered and performs quality assurance throughout the project life cycle.
* Identifies, analyzes, documents, and manages project risks, issues, assumptions, constraints, and dependencies. Develops mitigation actions, assigns ownership, tracks progress, and escalates items when appropriate.
* Develops, maintains, adjusts, and communicates project schedules, tasks, milestones, and dependencies in collaboration with the project team, client, subcontractors, and third-party providers.
* Supports resource planning by identifying resource needs, monitoring assignments and billable schedules, and escalating resource or scheduling constraints that could affect delivery.
* Manages equipment, software, licensing, outside services procurement, and delivery schedules applicable to the project.
* Responsible for meeting contractual performance requirements, deliverables, acceptance criteria, milestones, and due dates within the assigned project.
* Ensures compliance with applicable corporate, client, and government policies and requirements.
* Applies an understanding of government contract vehicles, Blanket Purchase Agreements, purchasing vehicles, and acquisition requirements to assigned project execution, reporting, invoicing, changes, and completion.
* Supports projects delivered under contract types that may include Firm Fixed Price, Time and Materials, Cost Plus, and As-a-Service arrangements.
* Leadership: Takes accountability for assigned project outcomes and demonstrates fiscal responsibility to the client, the project, and CDW-G. Establishes clear task ownership and follows up on assigned responsibilities.
* Builds trust and credibility through reliable delivery, sound judgment, business awareness, and professional stakeholder relationships.
* Contributes to the continuous improvement of project management standards, templates, tools, best practices, and shared knowledge resources.
* Communication: Determines and maintains the appropriate project documentation, including schedules, status reports, budget information, quality plans, risk and issue logs, decision records, action items, and closure documentation.
* Communicates clear, concise, audience-appropriate project updates to clients, sales, delivery teams, and other stakeholders. Escalates decisions and issues requiring leadership support.
* Leads effective in-person and virtual project meetings. Maintains focus, documents outcomes, assigns action items, and distributes timely follow-up communications.

new_jobs.title: Regional Quality Manager
new_jobs.description:
At the interface of design, engineering and supply logistics, REHAU Automotive and SRG Global combine to form RESRG - a leading global supplier of coated exterior systems and components. With a combined track record of over 160 years across four continents and 22 production sites, RESRG's 10,000 skilled team members manufacture the latest exterior systems and components for the world's leading automotive manufacturers.
  
  
RESRG Automotive is seeking you to join our team as a Regional Quality Manager!
  
  
Your Job
  
The Regional Quality Manager is responsible for improving manufacturing quality performance across multiple plant locations. This is a hands-on, plant-facing role focused on establishing common quality standards, strengthening problem-solving capability, and driving sustainable improvements in scrap, waste, defects, and cost of poor quality.
  
The Quality Manager will work directly with plant Quality, Operations, Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to identify systemic issues, implement common processes, and build the capability of site teams to solve problems at the root cause.
  
This position will spend significant time within the manufacturing facilities, working alongside plant teams to improve processes and ensure successful practices are replicated across the region.
  
  
What You Will Do in Your Role
  

* Establish and deploy common quality standards and expectations across manufacturing locations.
* Identify best practices within individual plants and standardize them across the region.
* Improve consistency in quality processes, documentation, reporting, and manufacturing controls.
* Support compliance with IATF 16949, customer-specific requirements, and internal quality standards.
* Partner with plant leadership to identify quality risks and close systemic gaps.
* Build plant capability in structured problem-solving methodologies, including 8D, A3, 5 Why, Fishbone, and root cause analysis.
* Coach Quality Managers, Engineers, Operations leaders, and frontline teams on effective problem solving.
* Facilitate complex or recurring problem-solving activities when additional regional support is needed.
* Ensure corrective actions address true root causes and are sustained over time.
* Create mechanisms to share lessons learned and prevent repeat issues across facilities.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives to reduce scrap, rework, defects, waste, and Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ).
* Use quality and operational data to identify the largest opportunities for improvement.
* Support plant locations in developing measurable improvement plans and tracking results.
* Identify recurring issues across locations and drive regional countermeasures.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to eliminate quality-related process waste.
* Spend significant time at plant locations assessing processes and supporting improvement activity.
* Provide hands-on support for significant quality or manufacturing issues.
* Assist plants with customer complaints, containment, corrective actions, and systemic quality issues.
* Support APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA, and Layered Process Audits where needed.
* Help underperforming sites establish disciplined quality improvement plans.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or related field preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive quality experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Strong automotive manufacturing experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading structured problem-solving and continuous improvement activities.
* Strong working knowledge of IATF 16949 and automotive core tools, including APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, and MSA.
* Demonstrated ability to reduce scrap, defects, waste, and cost of poor quality.
* Ability to coach and influence plant teams without relying solely on direct reporting authority.
* Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.
* Ability to travel regularly among regional manufacturing facilities.

What Will Put You Ahead
  

* Experience supporting multiple manufacturing locations.
* Experience with injection molding, paint, plating, or automotive exterior components.
* Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, ASQ certification, or equivalent structured problem-solving experience.
* VDA 6.3 experience.

Our Benefits
  
Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.
  
  
Equal Opportunities
  
Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. This employer uses E-Verify.

We’re hiring a Behavioral Health Case Manager to help patients access, remain engaged in, and transition between the services they need. This role will support patients with complex behavioral health needs, including those moving between levels of care, while maintaining the flexibility to support outpatient psychiatry and therapy.

You will work closely with patients, clinicians, internal program teams, insurers, and external partners to remove barriers, coordinate services, and close the loop on referrals and transitions. You will not provide psychotherapy, diagnose patients, or make independent clinical or level-of-care decisions. You will be expected to recognize changes in risk or acuity and escalate promptly to the appropriate clinician.

  

**About Talkiatry:**
--------------------

Talkiatry is transforming mental health care by making high-quality psychiatry more accessible, human, and sustainable for both patients and clinicians. Co-founded by a patient and a triple-board-certified psychiatrist, we were built to solve one of healthcare’s most urgent challenges: millions of people struggle to access mental health care, while clinicians face growing administrative burden and burnout. Through our technology-powered, in-network platform, we’re changing that, creating a better experience for patients and empowering clinicians to focus on delivering exceptional care.

  

Today, Talkiatry is the largest dedicated psychiatry practice in the U.S., with 750+ psychiatrists, 250+ therapists, and more than two million patient visits delivered nationwide. At our scale, every innovation has real impact. Every workflow we improve, every technology solution we build, and every patient experience we redesign helps thousands of clinicians provide better care to hundreds of thousands of patients. We’re not just growing quickly — we’re redefining how behavioral healthcare is delivered in America.

  

Joining Talkiatry means joining a mission-driven team that is solving complex problems at scale, driving meaningful change in healthcare, and building the future of mental health care with compassion, innovation, and purpose.

  

**You Will:**
-------------

* Works with patients across new and existing behavioral health programs, adjusting priorities based on patient need, acuity, and program demand.
* Support patients through enrollment, ongoing engagement, discharge, step-down, and return to outpatient care, with clear ownership of each transition until the next service is confirmed.
* Conduct timely outreach, identify barriers to care, and help patients navigate benefits, transportation, community resources, specialty services, and other supports.
* Coordinate closely with psychiatrists, psychiatric mental health nurse practitioners, therapists, primary care providers, and external treatment partners.
* Identify changes in patient risk, engagement, or functioning and escalate clinical concerns according to established protocols.
* Participate in crisis coordination by facilitating referrals to emergency, inpatient, residential, or other higher-acuity services under clinical direction.
* Manage inbound and outbound referrals, including communication with insurers and partner organizations, transfer of necessary records, and confirmation that handoffs are completed.
* Document case management activity and patient communication accurately and on time in the electronic health record to support continuity, quality reporting, and compliant billing.
* Maintain current knowledge of internal programs and external resources and contribute to improving the team's service repository and referral pathways.
* Track workload, referral status, barriers, outcomes, and care transitions, and use that information to identify operational gaps.
* Help build and refine case management workflows as Talkiatry expands its services for patients with more complex care needs.

**You Have:**
-------------

* A bachelor's degree in social work, psychology, counseling, public health, human services, or a related field.
* At least three years of behavioral health case management, care coordination, discharge planning, or healthcare navigation experience.
* Direct experience supporting higher-acuity behavioral health populations, including crisis care, discharge planning, structured treatment settings, or transitions between levels of care.
* The ability to work independently, manage multiple active cases, prioritize time-sensitive needs, and follow work through to completion.
* Strong judgment about when a situation requires escalation to a clinical review or immediate emergency workflows.
* Experience working with multidisciplinary clinical teams and external healthcare or community partners.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and experience documenting work in an electronic health record or care management platform and experience using AI tools to increase efficiency.
* Comfort working in a virtual environment and adapting as programs, workflows, and responsibilities evolve.

Licensure is not required. An LMSW, LSW, LPC, LMHC, CADC, CASAC, or other relevant credential may be considered, but this position does not provide psychotherapy or perform clinical services.

**How You Work:**
-----------------

* Patient centered. You listen carefully, communicate clearly, and help patients navigate difficult systems without losing ownership of the next step
* Strong follow through. You track details, close loops, and deliver on commitments
* Sound judgment. You understand the boundary between coordination and clinical decision-making and escalate concerns quickly
* Comfort with change. You can work effectively while new programs and workflows are still being bui

Key Responsibilities
  
Required Qualifications

* 8+ years of experience in technology, application development, systems integration, or solution architecture.
* 3+ years of experience leading technical teams, engineering initiatives, or complex technology projects.
* Strong understanding of contact center technology and operations.
* Experience designing and implementing solutions involving multiple applications and systems.
* Experience with APIs, web services, data integration, and application architecture.
* Hands-on technical background with the ability to review designs, guide developers, and troubleshooting complex issues.

* Familiarity with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, CRM systems, and customer communication platforms.

* Familiarity with React, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern web application architecture.
* Experience with workflow automation, AI-assisted applications, and agent productivity tools.
